+#[test]
+fn d1_step8_unregistered_overlay_custom_exports_without_a_format_code() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let xlsx = dir.path().join("phantom.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet("S");
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(1.0));
+    let phantom = FormatId::Custom(PeerId::new(777), 0);
+    assert!(wb.formats().lookup(phantom).is_none());
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, phantom);
+
+    let report = export_xlsx_path(&wb, &registry, &xlsx, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report), 1);
+
+    let bytes = fs::read(&xlsx).unwrap();
+    let mut zip = zip::ZipArchive::new(std::io::Cursor::new(bytes.as_slice())).unwrap();
+    let mut styles = String::new();
+    {
+        use std::io::Read;
+        zip.by_name("xl/styles.xml")
+            .unwrap()
+            .read_to_string(&mut styles)
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    assert!(
+        styles.contains(r#"numFmtId="164""#),
+        "cellXfs references flattened phantom id"
+    );
+    assert!(
+        !styles.contains("<numFmt "),
+        "no formatCode is emitted for an unregistered overlay id"
+    );
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let rebound = imported
+        .workbook
+        .sheet(0)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay()
+        .get(0, 0)
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(rebound, FormatId::legacy_from_u32(FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID));
+    assert!(
+        imported.workbook.formats().lookup(rebound).is_none(),
+        "xlsx import accepts a style-bound custom numFmtId with no numFmt definition, \
+         leaving an unresolved overlay id"
+    );
+}

+    let final_log = OpLog::new();
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&imported.workbook, &final_log, "full-arc-b", &qbook_b).unwrap();
+    let (loaded_final, loaded_final_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_b).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_final_log.len(), 0);
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded_final), custom_codes(&imported.workbook));
+    for ((row, col), id) in loaded_final.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(

+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&loaded_final, &final_log, "full-arc-b", &qbook_c).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(file_tree_bytes(&qbook_b), file_tree_bytes(&qbook_c));

+#[test]
+fn unregistered_overlay_custom_exports_without_a_format_code_probe() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tmp_dir("phantom-overlay");
+    let xlsx = dir.join("phantom.xlsx");
+    let qbook = dir.join("phantom.qbook");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet("S");
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(1.0));
+    let phantom = FormatId::Custom(PeerId::new(777), 0);
+    assert!(wb.formats().lookup(phantom).is_none());
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, phantom);
+
+    let report = export_xlsx_path(&wb, &registry, &xlsx, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report), 1);
+
+    let bytes = fs::read(&xlsx).unwrap();
+    let mut zip = zip::ZipArchive::new(std::io::Cursor::new(bytes.as_slice())).unwrap();
+    let mut styles = String::new();
+    {
+        use std::io::Read;
+        zip.by_name("xl/styles.xml")
+            .unwrap()
+            .read_to_string(&mut styles)
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    assert!(styles.contains(r#"numFmtId="164""#));
+    assert!(!styles.contains(r#"<numFmt numFmtId="164""#));
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let rebound = imported
+        .workbook
+        .sheet(0)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay()
+        .get(0, 0)
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(rebound, FormatId::legacy_from_u32(FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID));
+    assert!(imported.workbook.formats().lookup(rebound).is_none());
+
+    ql_io::save_workbook(&imported.workbook, "phantom", &qbook).unwrap();
+    assert!(matches!(
+        ql_io::load_workbook(&qbook),
+        Err(ql_io::QbookError::MalformedFormatOverlay {
+            why: "format id not registered in FormatTable",
+            ..
+        })
+    ));
+    let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
+}

+#![allow(deprecated)]

+use ql_io::{load_workbook_with_oplog, save_workbook_with_oplog, OPLOG_FILENAME, OPLOG_MAGIC};

+    XlsxImportOptions,

+use ql_storage::{FormatId, Workbook, FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID};
+use ql_types::{PeerId, Value, LEGACY_PEER};
+use std::collections::BTreeMap;
+use std::fs;
+use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
+
+fn flatten_count(report: &ql_io_xlsx::XlsxExportReport) -> usize {
+    report
+        .dropped_features
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|f| {
+            matches!(
+                f.kind,
+                UnsupportedFeatureKind::Other("multi-peer-format-id-flatten")
+            )
+        })
+        .count()
+}
+
+fn file_tree_bytes(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
+    fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, out: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) {
+        let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = fs::read_dir(path)
+            .unwrap()
+            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
+            .collect();
+        entries.sort();
+        for entry in entries {
+            if entry.is_dir() {
+                walk(root, &entry, out);
+            } else {
+                let rel = entry
+                    .strip_prefix(root)
+                    .unwrap()
+                    .to_string_lossy()
+                    .replace('\\', "/");
+                out.insert(rel, fs::read(&entry).unwrap());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
+    walk(root, root, &mut out);
+    out
+}
+
+fn custom_codes(workbook: &Workbook) -> Vec<(FormatId, String)> {
+    let mut rows: Vec<_> = workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| (id, code.to_string()))
+        .collect();
+    rows.sort();
+    rows
+}

+fn d1_step8_full_arc_multi_peer_qbook_xlsx_qbook_round_trip() {

+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();

+
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(42));
+    let peer42 = wb.formats_mut().intern("yyyy-mm-dd");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(99));
+    let peer99 = wb.formats_mut().intern("0.0000%");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(LEGACY_PEER);
+    let legacy = wb.formats_mut().intern("#,##0.00 USD");
+    let builtin = FormatId::Builtin(14);
+
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(45000.0));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 1, 0, Value::Number(0.42));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 2, 0, Value::Number(1234.56));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 3, 0, Value::Number(45001.0));
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, peer42);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(1, 0, peer99);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(2, 0, legacy);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(3, 0, builtin);
+
+    let mut oplog = OpLog::new();
+    oplog
+        .append(Op::AddSheet {
+            name: "Sheet1".to_string(),
+            chunk_rows: 16,
+        })
+        .unwrap();
+    for (row, value) in [(0, 45000.0), (1, 0.42), (2, 1234.56), (3, 45001.0)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::PutValue {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                value: CellWireValue::Number(value),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (id, string) in [
+        (peer42, "yyyy-mm-dd"),
+        (peer99, "0.0000%"),
+        (legacy, "#,##0.00 USD"),
+    ] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::RegisterFormat {
+                id: FormatIdWire::from_storage(id),
+                string: string.to_string(),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (row, id) in [(0, peer42), (1, peer99), (2, legacy), (3, builtin)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::SetCellFormat {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                id: Some(FormatIdWire::from_storage(id)),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }

+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&wb, &oplog, "d1-step8-a", &qbook_a).unwrap();
+    let oplog_bytes = fs::read(qbook_a.join(OPLOG_FILENAME)).unwrap();
+    assert!(oplog_bytes.starts_with(&OPLOG_MAGIC));
+
+    let (loaded, loaded_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_a).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded), custom_codes(&wb));
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(0, 0),
+        Some(peer42)
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(1, 0),
+        Some(peer99)
+    );
+    let loaded_ops: Vec<Op> = loaded_log.iter().collect::<Result<_, _>>().unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_ops.len(), 12);
+
+    let report_a =

+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_a), 2);
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx_a,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let mut imported_codes: Vec<String> = imported
+        .workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| {
+            assert!(matches!(id, FormatId::Custom(peer, _) if peer == LEGACY_PEER));
+            code.to_string()
+        })
+        .collect();
+    imported_codes.sort();
+    assert_eq!(
+        imported_codes,
+        vec![
+            "#,##0.00 USD".to_string(),
+            "0.0000%".to_string(),
+            "yyyy-mm-dd".to_string()
+        ]
+    );
+    for ((row, col), id) in imported.workbook.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(
+            imported.workbook.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),
+            "imported overlay at row {row} must resolve in FormatTable"
+        );
+    }
+
+    let report_b = export_xlsx_path(
+        &imported.workbook,
+        &registry,
+        &xlsx_b,
+        XlsxExportOptions::default(),
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_b), 0);
+
+    let final_log = OpLog::new();
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&imported.workbook, &final_log, "d1-step8-b", &qbook_b).unwrap();
+    let (loaded_final, loaded_final_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_b).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_final_log.len(), 0);
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded_final), custom_codes(&imported.workbook));
+    for ((row, col), id) in loaded_final.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(
+            loaded_final.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),

+    assert_eq!(

+        "LEGACY-only post-xlsx qbook save should be byte-stable"
+    );

+#[test]
+fn d1_step8_unregistered_overlay_custom_exports_without_a_format_code() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let xlsx = dir.path().join("phantom.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet("S");
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(1.0));
+    let phantom = FormatId::Custom(PeerId::new(777), 0);
+    assert!(wb.formats().lookup(phantom).is_none());
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, phantom);
+
+    let report = export_xlsx_path(&wb, &registry, &xlsx, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report), 1);
+
+    let bytes = fs::read(&xlsx).unwrap();
+    let mut zip = zip::ZipArchive::new(std::io::Cursor::new(bytes.as_slice())).unwrap();
+    let mut styles = String::new();
+    {
+        use std::io::Read;
+        zip.by_name("xl/styles.xml")
+            .unwrap()
+            .read_to_string(&mut styles)
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    assert!(
+        styles.contains(r#"numFmtId="164""#),
+        "cellXfs references flattened phantom id"
+    );
+    assert!(
+        !styles.contains("<numFmt "),
+        "no formatCode is emitted for an unregistered overlay id"
+    );
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let rebound = imported
+        .workbook
+        .sheet(0)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay()
+        .get(0, 0)
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(rebound, FormatId::legacy_from_u32(FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID));
+    assert!(
+        imported.workbook.formats().lookup(rebound).is_none(),
+        "xlsx import accepts a style-bound custom numFmtId with no numFmt definition, \
+         leaving an unresolved overlay id"
+    );
+}

+    assert_eq!(loaded_final_log.len(), 0);

+    for ((row, col), id) in loaded_final.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {

+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&loaded_final, &final_log, "full-arc-b", &qbook_c).unwrap();

+#[test]
+fn unregistered_overlay_custom_exports_without_a_format_code_probe() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tmp_dir("phantom-overlay");
+    let xlsx = dir.join("phantom.xlsx");
+    let qbook = dir.join("phantom.qbook");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet("S");
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(1.0));
+    let phantom = FormatId::Custom(PeerId::new(777), 0);
+    assert!(wb.formats().lookup(phantom).is_none());
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, phantom);
+
+    let report = export_xlsx_path(&wb, &registry, &xlsx, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report), 1);
+
+    let bytes = fs::read(&xlsx).unwrap();
+    let mut zip = zip::ZipArchive::new(std::io::Cursor::new(bytes.as_slice())).unwrap();
+    let mut styles = String::new();
+    {
+        use std::io::Read;
+        zip.by_name("xl/styles.xml")
+            .unwrap()
+            .read_to_string(&mut styles)
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    assert!(styles.contains(r#"numFmtId="164""#));
+    assert!(!styles.contains(r#"<numFmt numFmtId="164""#));
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let rebound = imported
+        .workbook
+        .sheet(0)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay()
+        .get(0, 0)
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(rebound, FormatId::legacy_from_u32(FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID));
+    assert!(imported.workbook.formats().lookup(rebound).is_none());
+
+    ql_io::save_workbook(&imported.workbook, "phantom", &qbook).unwrap();
+    assert!(matches!(
+        ql_io::load_workbook(&qbook),
+        Err(ql_io::QbookError::MalformedFormatOverlay {
+            why: "format id not registered in FormatTable",
+            ..
+        })
+    ));
+    let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
+}

+#![allow(deprecated)]

+use ql_io::{load_workbook_with_oplog, save_workbook_with_oplog, OPLOG_FILENAME, OPLOG_MAGIC};

+    XlsxImportOptions,

+use ql_storage::{FormatId, Workbook, FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID};
+use ql_types::{PeerId, Value, LEGACY_PEER};
+use std::collections::BTreeMap;
+use std::fs;
+use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
+
+fn flatten_count(report: &ql_io_xlsx::XlsxExportReport) -> usize {
+    report
+        .dropped_features
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|f| {
+            matches!(
+                f.kind,
+                UnsupportedFeatureKind::Other("multi-peer-format-id-flatten")
+            )
+        })
+        .count()
+}
+
+fn file_tree_bytes(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
+    fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, out: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) {
+        let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = fs::read_dir(path)
+            .unwrap()
+            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
+            .collect();
+        entries.sort();
+        for entry in entries {
+            if entry.is_dir() {
+                walk(root, &entry, out);
+            } else {
+                let rel = entry
+                    .strip_prefix(root)
+                    .unwrap()
+                    .to_string_lossy()
+                    .replace('\\', "/");
+                out.insert(rel, fs::read(&entry).unwrap());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
+    walk(root, root, &mut out);
+    out
+}
+
+fn custom_codes(workbook: &Workbook) -> Vec<(FormatId, String)> {
+    let mut rows: Vec<_> = workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| (id, code.to_string()))
+        .collect();
+    rows.sort();
+    rows
+}

+fn d1_step8_full_arc_multi_peer_qbook_xlsx_qbook_round_trip() {

+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet_with_chunk_rows("Sheet1", 16);
+
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(42));
+    let peer42 = wb.formats_mut().intern("yyyy-mm-dd");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(99));
+    let peer99 = wb.formats_mut().intern("0.0000%");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(LEGACY_PEER);
+    let legacy = wb.formats_mut().intern("#,##0.00 USD");
+    let builtin = FormatId::Builtin(14);
+
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(45000.0));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 1, 0, Value::Number(0.42));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 2, 0, Value::Number(1234.56));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 3, 0, Value::Number(45001.0));
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, peer42);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(1, 0, peer99);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(2, 0, legacy);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(3, 0, builtin);
+
+    let mut oplog = OpLog::new();
+    oplog
+        .append(Op::AddSheet {
+            name: "Sheet1".to_string(),
+            chunk_rows: 16,
+        })
+        .unwrap();
+    for (row, value) in [(0, 45000.0), (1, 0.42), (2, 1234.56), (3, 45001.0)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::PutValue {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                value: CellWireValue::Number(value),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (id, string) in [
+        (peer42, "yyyy-mm-dd"),
+        (peer99, "0.0000%"),
+        (legacy, "#,##0.00 USD"),
+    ] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::RegisterFormat {
+                id: FormatIdWire::from_storage(id),
+                string: string.to_string(),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (row, id) in [(0, peer42), (1, peer99), (2, legacy), (3, builtin)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::SetCellFormat {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                id: Some(FormatIdWire::from_storage(id)),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }

+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&wb, &oplog, "d1-step8-a", &qbook_a).unwrap();
+    let oplog_bytes = fs::read(qbook_a.join(OPLOG_FILENAME)).unwrap();
+    assert!(oplog_bytes.starts_with(&OPLOG_MAGIC));
+
+    let (loaded, loaded_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_a).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded), custom_codes(&wb));
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(0, 0),
+        Some(peer42)
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(1, 0),
+        Some(peer99)
+    );
+    let loaded_ops: Vec<Op> = loaded_log.iter().collect::<Result<_, _>>().unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_ops.len(), 12);
+
+    let report_a =
+        export_xlsx_path(&loaded, &registry, &xlsx_a, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_a), 2);
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx_a,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let mut imported_codes: Vec<String> = imported
+        .workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| {
+            assert!(matches!(id, FormatId::Custom(peer, _) if peer == LEGACY_PEER));
+            code.to_string()
+        })
+        .collect();
+    imported_codes.sort();
+    assert_eq!(
+        imported_codes,
+        vec![
+            "#,##0.00 USD".to_string(),
+            "0.0000%".to_string(),
+            "yyyy-mm-dd".to_string()
+        ]
+    );
+    for ((row, col), id) in imported.workbook.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(
+            imported.workbook.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),
+            "imported overlay at row {row} must resolve in FormatTable"
+        );
+    }
+
+    let report_b = export_xlsx_path(
+        &imported.workbook,
+        &registry,
+        &xlsx_b,
+        XlsxExportOptions::default(),
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_b), 0);
+
+    let final_log = OpLog::new();
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&imported.workbook, &final_log, "d1-step8-b", &qbook_b).unwrap();
+    let (loaded_final, loaded_final_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_b).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_final_log.len(), 0);
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded_final), custom_codes(&imported.workbook));
+    for ((row, col), id) in loaded_final.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(
+            loaded_final.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),
+            "final qbook overlay at row {row} must resolve in FormatTable"

+    }

+    assert_eq!(

+    );

+#[test]
+fn d1_step8_unregistered_overlay_custom_exports_without_a_format_code() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let xlsx = dir.path().join("phantom.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet("S");
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(1.0));
+    let phantom = FormatId::Custom(PeerId::new(777), 0);
+    assert!(wb.formats().lookup(phantom).is_none());
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, phantom);
+
+    let report = export_xlsx_path(&wb, &registry, &xlsx, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report), 1);
+
+    let bytes = fs::read(&xlsx).unwrap();
+    let mut zip = zip::ZipArchive::new(std::io::Cursor::new(bytes.as_slice())).unwrap();
+    let mut styles = String::new();
+    {
+        use std::io::Read;
+        zip.by_name("xl/styles.xml")
+            .unwrap()
+            .read_to_string(&mut styles)
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    assert!(
+        styles.contains(r#"numFmtId="164""#),
+        "cellXfs references flattened phantom id"
+    );
+    assert!(
+        !styles.contains("<numFmt "),
+        "no formatCode is emitted for an unregistered overlay id"
+    );
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let rebound = imported
+        .workbook
+        .sheet(0)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay()
+        .get(0, 0)
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(rebound, FormatId::legacy_from_u32(FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID));
+    assert!(
+        imported.workbook.formats().lookup(rebound).is_none(),
+        "xlsx import accepts a style-bound custom numFmtId with no numFmt definition, \
+         leaving an unresolved overlay id"
+    );
+}

+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&loaded_final, &final_log, "full-arc-b", &qbook_c).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(file_tree_bytes(&qbook_b), file_tree_bytes(&qbook_c));

+#[test]
+fn unregistered_overlay_custom_exports_without_a_format_code_probe() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tmp_dir("phantom-overlay");
+    let xlsx = dir.join("phantom.xlsx");
+    let qbook = dir.join("phantom.qbook");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet("S");
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(1.0));
+    let phantom = FormatId::Custom(PeerId::new(777), 0);
+    assert!(wb.formats().lookup(phantom).is_none());
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, phantom);
+
+    let report = export_xlsx_path(&wb, &registry, &xlsx, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report), 1);
+
+    let bytes = fs::read(&xlsx).unwrap();
+    let mut zip = zip::ZipArchive::new(std::io::Cursor::new(bytes.as_slice())).unwrap();
+    let mut styles = String::new();
+    {
+        use std::io::Read;
+        zip.by_name("xl/styles.xml")
+            .unwrap()
+            .read_to_string(&mut styles)
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    assert!(styles.contains(r#"numFmtId="164""#));
+    assert!(!styles.contains(r#"<numFmt numFmtId="164""#));
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let rebound = imported
+        .workbook
+        .sheet(0)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay()
+        .get(0, 0)
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(rebound, FormatId::legacy_from_u32(FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID));
+    assert!(imported.workbook.formats().lookup(rebound).is_none());
+
+    ql_io::save_workbook(&imported.workbook, "phantom", &qbook).unwrap();
+    assert!(matches!(
+        ql_io::load_workbook(&qbook),
+        Err(ql_io::QbookError::MalformedFormatOverlay {
+            why: "format id not registered in FormatTable",
+            ..
+        })
+    ));
+    let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
+}

+#![allow(deprecated)]

+use ql_io::{load_workbook_with_oplog, save_workbook_with_oplog, OPLOG_FILENAME, OPLOG_MAGIC};

+    export_xlsx_path, import_xlsx_path, RecomputeMode, UnsupportedFeatureKind, XlsxExportOptions,
+    XlsxImportOptions,
+};

+use ql_storage::{FormatId, Workbook, FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID};
+use ql_types::{PeerId, Value, LEGACY_PEER};
+use std::collections::BTreeMap;
+use std::fs;
+use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
+
+fn flatten_count(report: &ql_io_xlsx::XlsxExportReport) -> usize {
+    report
+        .dropped_features
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|f| {
+            matches!(
+                f.kind,
+                UnsupportedFeatureKind::Other("multi-peer-format-id-flatten")
+            )
+        })
+        .count()
+}
+
+fn file_tree_bytes(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
+    fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, out: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) {
+        let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = fs::read_dir(path)
+            .unwrap()
+            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
+            .collect();
+        entries.sort();
+        for entry in entries {
+            if entry.is_dir() {
+                walk(root, &entry, out);
+            } else {
+                let rel = entry
+                    .strip_prefix(root)
+                    .unwrap()
+                    .to_string_lossy()
+                    .replace('\\', "/");
+                out.insert(rel, fs::read(&entry).unwrap());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
+    walk(root, root, &mut out);
+    out
+}
+
+fn custom_codes(workbook: &Workbook) -> Vec<(FormatId, String)> {
+    let mut rows: Vec<_> = workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| (id, code.to_string()))
+        .collect();
+    rows.sort();
+    rows
+}

+#[test]
+fn d1_step8_full_arc_multi_peer_qbook_xlsx_qbook_round_trip() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let qbook_a = dir.path().join("a.qbook");
+    let qbook_b = dir.path().join("b.qbook");
+    let qbook_c = dir.path().join("c.qbook");
+    let xlsx_a = dir.path().join("a.xlsx");
+    let xlsx_b = dir.path().join("b.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet_with_chunk_rows("Sheet1", 16);
+
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(42));
+    let peer42 = wb.formats_mut().intern("yyyy-mm-dd");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(99));
+    let peer99 = wb.formats_mut().intern("0.0000%");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(LEGACY_PEER);
+    let legacy = wb.formats_mut().intern("#,##0.00 USD");
+    let builtin = FormatId::Builtin(14);
+
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(45000.0));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 1, 0, Value::Number(0.42));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 2, 0, Value::Number(1234.56));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 3, 0, Value::Number(45001.0));
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, peer42);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(1, 0, peer99);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(2, 0, legacy);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(3, 0, builtin);
+
+    let mut oplog = OpLog::new();
+    oplog
+        .append(Op::AddSheet {
+            name: "Sheet1".to_string(),
+            chunk_rows: 16,
+        })
+        .unwrap();
+    for (row, value) in [(0, 45000.0), (1, 0.42), (2, 1234.56), (3, 45001.0)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::PutValue {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                value: CellWireValue::Number(value),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (id, string) in [
+        (peer42, "yyyy-mm-dd"),
+        (peer99, "0.0000%"),
+        (legacy, "#,##0.00 USD"),
+    ] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::RegisterFormat {
+                id: FormatIdWire::from_storage(id),
+                string: string.to_string(),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (row, id) in [(0, peer42), (1, peer99), (2, legacy), (3, builtin)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::SetCellFormat {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                id: Some(FormatIdWire::from_storage(id)),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&wb, &oplog, "d1-step8-a", &qbook_a).unwrap();
+    let oplog_bytes = fs::read(qbook_a.join(OPLOG_FILENAME)).unwrap();
+    assert!(oplog_bytes.starts_with(&OPLOG_MAGIC));
+
+    let (loaded, loaded_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_a).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded), custom_codes(&wb));
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(0, 0),
+        Some(peer42)
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(1, 0),
+        Some(peer99)
+    );
+    let loaded_ops: Vec<Op> = loaded_log.iter().collect::<Result<_, _>>().unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_ops.len(), 12);
+
+    let report_a =
+        export_xlsx_path(&loaded, &registry, &xlsx_a, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_a), 2);
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx_a,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let mut imported_codes: Vec<String> = imported
+        .workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| {
+            assert!(matches!(id, FormatId::Custom(peer, _) if peer == LEGACY_PEER));
+            code.to_string()
+        })
+        .collect();
+    imported_codes.sort();
+    assert_eq!(
+        imported_codes,
+        vec![
+            "#,##0.00 USD".to_string(),
+            "0.0000%".to_string(),
+            "yyyy-mm-dd".to_string()
+        ]
+    );
+    for ((row, col), id) in imported.workbook.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(
+            imported.workbook.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),
+            "imported overlay at row {row} must resolve in FormatTable"
+        );
+    }
+
+    let report_b = export_xlsx_path(
+        &imported.workbook,
+        &registry,
+        &xlsx_b,
+        XlsxExportOptions::default(),
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_b), 0);
+
+    let final_log = OpLog::new();
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&imported.workbook, &final_log, "d1-step8-b", &qbook_b).unwrap();
+    let (loaded_final, loaded_final_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_b).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_final_log.len(), 0);
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded_final), custom_codes(&imported.workbook));
+    for ((row, col), id) in loaded_final.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(
+            loaded_final.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),
+            "final qbook overlay at row {row} must resolve in FormatTable"
+        );
+    }
+
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&loaded_final, &final_log, "d1-step8-b", &qbook_c).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(
+        file_tree_bytes(&qbook_b),
+        file_tree_bytes(&qbook_c),
+        "LEGACY-only post-xlsx qbook save should be byte-stable"
+    );
+}

+fn d1_step8_unregistered_overlay_custom_exports_without_a_format_code() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let xlsx = dir.path().join("phantom.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet("S");
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(1.0));
+    let phantom = FormatId::Custom(PeerId::new(777), 0);
+    assert!(wb.formats().lookup(phantom).is_none());
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, phantom);
+
+    let report = export_xlsx_path(&wb, &registry, &xlsx, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report), 1);
+
+    let bytes = fs::read(&xlsx).unwrap();
+    let mut zip = zip::ZipArchive::new(std::io::Cursor::new(bytes.as_slice())).unwrap();
+    let mut styles = String::new();
+    {
+        use std::io::Read;
+        zip.by_name("xl/styles.xml")
+            .unwrap()
+            .read_to_string(&mut styles)
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    assert!(
+        styles.contains(r#"numFmtId="164""#),
+        "cellXfs references flattened phantom id"
+    );
+    assert!(
+        !styles.contains("<numFmt "),
+        "no formatCode is emitted for an unregistered overlay id"
+    );
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let rebound = imported
+        .workbook
+        .sheet(0)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay()
+        .get(0, 0)
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(rebound, FormatId::legacy_from_u32(FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID));
+    assert!(
+        imported.workbook.formats().lookup(rebound).is_none(),
+        "xlsx import accepts a style-bound custom numFmtId with no numFmt definition, \
+         leaving an unresolved overlay id"
+    );
+}

+#![allow(deprecated)]

+use ql_io::{load_workbook_with_oplog, save_workbook_with_oplog, OPLOG_FILENAME, OPLOG_MAGIC};
+use ql_io_xlsx::{
+    export_xlsx_path, import_xlsx_path, RecomputeMode, UnsupportedFeatureKind, XlsxExportOptions,
+    XlsxImportOptions,
+};
+use ql_oplog::{CellWireValue, FormatIdWire, Op, OpLog};
+use ql_storage::{FormatId, Workbook, FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID};
+use ql_types::{PeerId, Value, LEGACY_PEER};
+use std::collections::BTreeMap;
+use std::fs;
+use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
+
+fn flatten_count(report: &ql_io_xlsx::XlsxExportReport) -> usize {
+    report
+        .dropped_features
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|f| {
+            matches!(
+                f.kind,
+                UnsupportedFeatureKind::Other("multi-peer-format-id-flatten")
+            )
+        })
+        .count()
+}
+
+fn file_tree_bytes(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
+    fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, out: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) {
+        let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = fs::read_dir(path)
+            .unwrap()
+            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
+            .collect();
+        entries.sort();
+        for entry in entries {
+            if entry.is_dir() {
+                walk(root, &entry, out);
+            } else {
+                let rel = entry
+                    .strip_prefix(root)
+                    .unwrap()
+                    .to_string_lossy()
+                    .replace('\\', "/");
+                out.insert(rel, fs::read(&entry).unwrap());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
+    walk(root, root, &mut out);
+    out
+}
+
+fn custom_codes(workbook: &Workbook) -> Vec<(FormatId, String)> {
+    let mut rows: Vec<_> = workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| (id, code.to_string()))
+        .collect();
+    rows.sort();
+    rows
+}

+        .unwrap()

+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(rebound, FormatId::legacy_from_u32(FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID));
+    assert!(imported.workbook.formats().lookup(rebound).is_none());

+    assert!(matches!(
+        ql_io::load_workbook(&qbook),
+        Err(ql_io::QbookError::MalformedFormatOverlay {
+            why: "format id not registered in FormatTable",

+fn flatten_count(report: &ql_io_xlsx::XlsxExportReport) -> usize {
+    report
+        .dropped_features
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|f| {
+            matches!(
+                f.kind,

+            )
+        })
+        .count()
+}
+
+fn file_tree_bytes(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
+    fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, out: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) {
+        let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = fs::read_dir(path)
+            .unwrap()
+            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
+            .collect();
+        entries.sort();
+        for entry in entries {
+            if entry.is_dir() {
+                walk(root, &entry, out);
+            } else {
+                let rel = entry
+                    .strip_prefix(root)
+                    .unwrap()
+                    .to_string_lossy()
+                    .replace('\\', "/");
+                out.insert(rel, fs::read(&entry).unwrap());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
+    walk(root, root, &mut out);
+    out
+}

+fn custom_codes(workbook: &Workbook) -> Vec<(FormatId, String)> {
+    let mut rows: Vec<_> = workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| (id, code.to_string()))
+        .collect();
+    rows.sort();
+    rows

+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()

+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report), 1);
+
+    let bytes = fs::read(&xlsx).unwrap();
+    let mut zip = zip::ZipArchive::new(std::io::Cursor::new(bytes.as_slice())).unwrap();
+    let mut styles = String::new();
+    {
+        use std::io::Read;
+        zip.by_name("xl/styles.xml")
+            .unwrap()
+            .read_to_string(&mut styles)
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    assert!(styles.contains(r#"numFmtId="164""#));
+    assert!(!styles.contains(r#"<numFmt numFmtId="164""#));
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let rebound = imported
+        .workbook
+        .sheet(0)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay()
+        .get(0, 0)
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(rebound, FormatId::legacy_from_u32(FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID));
+    assert!(imported.workbook.formats().lookup(rebound).is_none());
+
+    ql_io::save_workbook(&imported.workbook, "phantom", &qbook).unwrap();
+    assert!(matches!(
+        ql_io::load_workbook(&qbook),
+        Err(ql_io::QbookError::MalformedFormatOverlay {
+            why: "format id not registered in FormatTable",
+            ..
+        })
+    ));
+    let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
+}

+#![allow(deprecated)]

+use ql_io::{load_workbook_with_oplog, save_workbook_with_oplog, OPLOG_FILENAME, OPLOG_MAGIC};

+    XlsxImportOptions,
+};

+use ql_storage::{FormatId, Workbook, FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID};
+use ql_types::{PeerId, Value, LEGACY_PEER};
+use std::collections::BTreeMap;
+use std::fs;
+use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
+
+fn flatten_count(report: &ql_io_xlsx::XlsxExportReport) -> usize {
+    report
+        .dropped_features
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|f| {
+            matches!(
+                f.kind,
+                UnsupportedFeatureKind::Other("multi-peer-format-id-flatten")
+            )
+        })
+        .count()
+}
+
+fn file_tree_bytes(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
+    fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, out: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) {
+        let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = fs::read_dir(path)
+            .unwrap()
+            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
+            .collect();
+        entries.sort();
+        for entry in entries {
+            if entry.is_dir() {
+                walk(root, &entry, out);
+            } else {
+                let rel = entry
+                    .strip_prefix(root)
+                    .unwrap()
+                    .to_string_lossy()
+                    .replace('\\', "/");
+                out.insert(rel, fs::read(&entry).unwrap());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
+    walk(root, root, &mut out);
+    out
+}
+
+fn custom_codes(workbook: &Workbook) -> Vec<(FormatId, String)> {
+    let mut rows: Vec<_> = workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| (id, code.to_string()))
+        .collect();
+    rows.sort();
+    rows
+}

+#[test]
+fn d1_step8_full_arc_multi_peer_qbook_xlsx_qbook_round_trip() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let qbook_a = dir.path().join("a.qbook");
+    let qbook_b = dir.path().join("b.qbook");
+    let qbook_c = dir.path().join("c.qbook");
+    let xlsx_a = dir.path().join("a.xlsx");
+    let xlsx_b = dir.path().join("b.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet_with_chunk_rows("Sheet1", 16);
+
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(42));
+    let peer42 = wb.formats_mut().intern("yyyy-mm-dd");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(99));
+    let peer99 = wb.formats_mut().intern("0.0000%");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(LEGACY_PEER);
+    let legacy = wb.formats_mut().intern("#,##0.00 USD");
+    let builtin = FormatId::Builtin(14);
+
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(45000.0));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 1, 0, Value::Number(0.42));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 2, 0, Value::Number(1234.56));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 3, 0, Value::Number(45001.0));
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, peer42);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(1, 0, peer99);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(2, 0, legacy);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(3, 0, builtin);
+
+    let mut oplog = OpLog::new();
+    oplog
+        .append(Op::AddSheet {
+            name: "Sheet1".to_string(),
+            chunk_rows: 16,
+        })
+        .unwrap();
+    for (row, value) in [(0, 45000.0), (1, 0.42), (2, 1234.56), (3, 45001.0)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::PutValue {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                value: CellWireValue::Number(value),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (id, string) in [
+        (peer42, "yyyy-mm-dd"),
+        (peer99, "0.0000%"),
+        (legacy, "#,##0.00 USD"),
+    ] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::RegisterFormat {
+                id: FormatIdWire::from_storage(id),
+                string: string.to_string(),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (row, id) in [(0, peer42), (1, peer99), (2, legacy), (3, builtin)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::SetCellFormat {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                id: Some(FormatIdWire::from_storage(id)),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }

+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&wb, &oplog, "d1-step8-a", &qbook_a).unwrap();
+    let oplog_bytes = fs::read(qbook_a.join(OPLOG_FILENAME)).unwrap();
+    assert!(oplog_bytes.starts_with(&OPLOG_MAGIC));

+    let (loaded, loaded_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_a).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded), custom_codes(&wb));
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(0, 0),
+        Some(peer42)
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(1, 0),
+        Some(peer99)
+    );
+    let loaded_ops: Vec<Op> = loaded_log.iter().collect::<Result<_, _>>().unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_ops.len(), 12);
+
+    let report_a =
+        export_xlsx_path(&loaded, &registry, &xlsx_a, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_a), 2);
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx_a,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let mut imported_codes: Vec<String> = imported
+        .workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| {
+            assert!(matches!(id, FormatId::Custom(peer, _) if peer == LEGACY_PEER));
+            code.to_string()
+        })
+        .collect();
+    imported_codes.sort();
+    assert_eq!(
+        imported_codes,
+        vec![
+            "#,##0.00 USD".to_string(),
+            "0.0000%".to_string(),
+            "yyyy-mm-dd".to_string()
+        ]
+    );
+    for ((row, col), id) in imported.workbook.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(
+            imported.workbook.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),
+            "imported overlay at row {row} must resolve in FormatTable"
+        );
+    }
+
+    let report_b = export_xlsx_path(
+        &imported.workbook,
+        &registry,
+        &xlsx_b,
+        XlsxExportOptions::default(),
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_b), 0);
+
+    let final_log = OpLog::new();
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&imported.workbook, &final_log, "d1-step8-b", &qbook_b).unwrap();
+    let (loaded_final, loaded_final_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_b).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_final_log.len(), 0);
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded_final), custom_codes(&imported.workbook));
+    for ((row, col), id) in loaded_final.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(
+            loaded_final.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),
+            "final qbook overlay at row {row} must resolve in FormatTable"
+        );
+    }
+
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&loaded_final, &final_log, "d1-step8-b", &qbook_c).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(
+        file_tree_bytes(&qbook_b),

+        "LEGACY-only post-xlsx qbook save should be byte-stable"
+    );

+#[test]
+fn d1_step8_unregistered_overlay_custom_exports_without_a_format_code() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let xlsx = dir.path().join("phantom.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet("S");
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(1.0));
+    let phantom = FormatId::Custom(PeerId::new(777), 0);
+    assert!(wb.formats().lookup(phantom).is_none());
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, phantom);
+
+    let report = export_xlsx_path(&wb, &registry, &xlsx, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report), 1);
+
+    let bytes = fs::read(&xlsx).unwrap();
+    let mut zip = zip::ZipArchive::new(std::io::Cursor::new(bytes.as_slice())).unwrap();
+    let mut styles = String::new();
+    {
+        use std::io::Read;
+        zip.by_name("xl/styles.xml")
+            .unwrap()
+            .read_to_string(&mut styles)
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    assert!(
+        styles.contains(r#"numFmtId="164""#),
+        "cellXfs references flattened phantom id"
+    );
+    assert!(
+        !styles.contains("<numFmt "),
+        "no formatCode is emitted for an unregistered overlay id"
+    );
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let rebound = imported
+        .workbook
+        .sheet(0)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay()
+        .get(0, 0)
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(rebound, FormatId::legacy_from_u32(FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID));
+    assert!(
+        imported.workbook.formats().lookup(rebound).is_none(),
+        "xlsx import accepts a style-bound custom numFmtId with no numFmt definition, \
+         leaving an unresolved overlay id"
+    );
+}

+
+fn flatten_count(report: &ql_io_xlsx::XlsxExportReport) -> usize {
+    report
+        .dropped_features
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|f| {
+            matches!(
+                f.kind,
+                UnsupportedFeatureKind::Other("multi-peer-format-id-flatten")
+            )
+        })
+        .count()
+}
+
+fn file_tree_bytes(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
+    fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, out: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) {
+        let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = fs::read_dir(path)
+            .unwrap()
+            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
+            .collect();
+        entries.sort();
+        for entry in entries {
+            if entry.is_dir() {
+                walk(root, &entry, out);
+            } else {
+                let rel = entry
+                    .strip_prefix(root)
+                    .unwrap()
+                    .to_string_lossy()
+                    .replace('\\', "/");
+                out.insert(rel, fs::read(&entry).unwrap());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
+    walk(root, root, &mut out);
+    out
+}

+    let mut rows: Vec<_> = workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| (id, code.to_string()))
+        .collect();
+    rows.sort();
+    rows
+}

+    wb.put_at(sheet, 3, 0, Value::Number(45001.0));
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, peer42);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(1, 0, peer99);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()

+fn d1_step8_unregistered_overlay_custom_exports_without_a_format_code() {

+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();

+    let mut styles = String::new();

+            .unwrap()
+            .read_to_string(&mut styles)
+            .unwrap();

+    );
+    assert!(

+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()

+    .unwrap();
+    let rebound = imported

+        .sheet(0)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay()
+        .get(0, 0)

+    assert_eq!(rebound, FormatId::legacy_from_u32(FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID));

+        ql_io::load_workbook(&qbook),

+            why: "format id not registered in FormatTable",
+            ..

+    ));

+    XlsxImportOptions,
+};

+
+fn flatten_count(report: &ql_io_xlsx::XlsxExportReport) -> usize {
+    report
+        .dropped_features
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|f| {
+            matches!(
+                f.kind,
+                UnsupportedFeatureKind::Other("multi-peer-format-id-flatten")
+            )
+        })
+        .count()
+}
+
+fn file_tree_bytes(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
+    fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, out: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) {
+        let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = fs::read_dir(path)
+            .unwrap()
+            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
+            .collect();
+        entries.sort();
+        for entry in entries {
+            if entry.is_dir() {
+                walk(root, &entry, out);
+            } else {
+                let rel = entry
+                    .strip_prefix(root)
+                    .unwrap()
+                    .to_string_lossy()
+                    .replace('\\', "/");
+                out.insert(rel, fs::read(&entry).unwrap());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
+    walk(root, root, &mut out);
+    out
+}
+
+fn custom_codes(workbook: &Workbook) -> Vec<(FormatId, String)> {
+    let mut rows: Vec<_> = workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| (id, code.to_string()))
+        .collect();
+    rows.sort();
+    rows
+}

+#[test]
+fn d1_step8_full_arc_multi_peer_qbook_xlsx_qbook_round_trip() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();

+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet_with_chunk_rows("Sheet1", 16);
+
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(42));
+    let peer42 = wb.formats_mut().intern("yyyy-mm-dd");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(99));
+    let peer99 = wb.formats_mut().intern("0.0000%");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(LEGACY_PEER);
+    let legacy = wb.formats_mut().intern("#,##0.00 USD");
+    let builtin = FormatId::Builtin(14);
+
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(45000.0));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 1, 0, Value::Number(0.42));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 2, 0, Value::Number(1234.56));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 3, 0, Value::Number(45001.0));
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, peer42);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(1, 0, peer99);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(2, 0, legacy);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(3, 0, builtin);
+
+    let mut oplog = OpLog::new();
+    oplog
+        .append(Op::AddSheet {
+            name: "Sheet1".to_string(),
+            chunk_rows: 16,
+        })
+        .unwrap();
+    for (row, value) in [(0, 45000.0), (1, 0.42), (2, 1234.56), (3, 45001.0)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::PutValue {

+                value: CellWireValue::Number(value),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }

+        (peer99, "0.0000%"),

+        oplog
+            .append(Op::RegisterFormat {
+                id: FormatIdWire::from_storage(id),

+            })
+            .unwrap();

+            .append(Op::SetCellFormat {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                id: Some(FormatIdWire::from_storage(id)),
+            })
+            .unwrap();

+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(

+    let (loaded_final, loaded_final_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_b).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_final_log.len(), 0);

+#[test]
+fn d1_step8_unregistered_overlay_custom_exports_without_a_format_code() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let xlsx = dir.path().join("phantom.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet("S");
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(1.0));
+    let phantom = FormatId::Custom(PeerId::new(777), 0);
+    assert!(wb.formats().lookup(phantom).is_none());
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, phantom);
+
+    let report = export_xlsx_path(&wb, &registry, &xlsx, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report), 1);
+
+    let bytes = fs::read(&xlsx).unwrap();
+    let mut zip = zip::ZipArchive::new(std::io::Cursor::new(bytes.as_slice())).unwrap();
+    let mut styles = String::new();
+    {
+        use std::io::Read;
+        zip.by_name("xl/styles.xml")
+            .unwrap()
+            .read_to_string(&mut styles)
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    assert!(
+        styles.contains(r#"numFmtId="164""#),
+        "cellXfs references flattened phantom id"
+    );
+    assert!(
+        !styles.contains("<numFmt "),
+        "no formatCode is emitted for an unregistered overlay id"
+    );
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let rebound = imported
+        .workbook
+        .sheet(0)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay()
+        .get(0, 0)
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(rebound, FormatId::legacy_from_u32(FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID));
+    assert!(
+        imported.workbook.formats().lookup(rebound).is_none(),
+        "xlsx import accepts a style-bound custom numFmtId with no numFmt definition, \
+         leaving an unresolved overlay id"
+    );
+}

+#![allow(deprecated)]
+
+use ql_io::{load_workbook_with_oplog, save_workbook_with_oplog, OPLOG_FILENAME, OPLOG_MAGIC};
+use ql_io_xlsx::{
+    export_xlsx_path, import_xlsx_path, RecomputeMode, UnsupportedFeatureKind, XlsxExportOptions,
+    XlsxImportOptions,
+};
+use ql_oplog::{CellWireValue, FormatIdWire, Op, OpLog};
+use ql_storage::{FormatId, Workbook, FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID};
+use ql_types::{PeerId, Value, LEGACY_PEER};
+use std::collections::BTreeMap;
+use std::fs;
+use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
+
+fn flatten_count(report: &ql_io_xlsx::XlsxExportReport) -> usize {
+    report
+        .dropped_features
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|f| {
+            matches!(
+                f.kind,
+                UnsupportedFeatureKind::Other("multi-peer-format-id-flatten")
+            )
+        })
+        .count()
+}
+
+fn file_tree_bytes(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
+    fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, out: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) {
+        let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = fs::read_dir(path)
+            .unwrap()
+            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
+            .collect();
+        entries.sort();
+        for entry in entries {
+            if entry.is_dir() {
+                walk(root, &entry, out);
+            } else {
+                let rel = entry
+                    .strip_prefix(root)
+                    .unwrap()
+                    .to_string_lossy()
+                    .replace('\\', "/");
+                out.insert(rel, fs::read(&entry).unwrap());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
+    walk(root, root, &mut out);
+    out
+}
+
+fn custom_codes(workbook: &Workbook) -> Vec<(FormatId, String)> {
+    let mut rows: Vec<_> = workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| (id, code.to_string()))
+        .collect();
+    rows.sort();
+    rows
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn d1_step8_full_arc_multi_peer_qbook_xlsx_qbook_round_trip() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let qbook_a = dir.path().join("a.qbook");
+    let qbook_b = dir.path().join("b.qbook");
+    let qbook_c = dir.path().join("c.qbook");
+    let xlsx_a = dir.path().join("a.xlsx");
+    let xlsx_b = dir.path().join("b.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet_with_chunk_rows("Sheet1", 16);
+
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(42));
+    let peer42 = wb.formats_mut().intern("yyyy-mm-dd");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(99));
+    let peer99 = wb.formats_mut().intern("0.0000%");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(LEGACY_PEER);
+    let legacy = wb.formats_mut().intern("#,##0.00 USD");
+    let builtin = FormatId::Builtin(14);
+
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(45000.0));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 1, 0, Value::Number(0.42));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 2, 0, Value::Number(1234.56));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 3, 0, Value::Number(45001.0));
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, peer42);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(1, 0, peer99);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(2, 0, legacy);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(3, 0, builtin);
+
+    let mut oplog = OpLog::new();
+    oplog
+        .append(Op::AddSheet {
+            name: "Sheet1".to_string(),
+            chunk_rows: 16,
+        })
+        .unwrap();
+    for (row, value) in [(0, 45000.0), (1, 0.42), (2, 1234.56), (3, 45001.0)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::PutValue {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                value: CellWireValue::Number(value),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (id, string) in [
+        (peer42, "yyyy-mm-dd"),
+        (peer99, "0.0000%"),
+        (legacy, "#,##0.00 USD"),
+    ] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::RegisterFormat {
+                id: FormatIdWire::from_storage(id),
+                string: string.to_string(),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (row, id) in [(0, peer42), (1, peer99), (2, legacy), (3, builtin)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::SetCellFormat {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                id: Some(FormatIdWire::from_storage(id)),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&wb, &oplog, "d1-step8-a", &qbook_a).unwrap();
+    let oplog_bytes = fs::read(qbook_a.join(OPLOG_FILENAME)).unwrap();
+    assert!(oplog_bytes.starts_with(&OPLOG_MAGIC));
+
+    let (loaded, loaded_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_a).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded), custom_codes(&wb));
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(0, 0),
+        Some(peer42)
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(1, 0),
+        Some(peer99)
+    );
+    let loaded_ops: Vec<Op> = loaded_log.iter().collect::<Result<_, _>>().unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_ops.len(), 12);
+
+    let report_a =
+        export_xlsx_path(&loaded, &registry, &xlsx_a, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_a), 2);
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx_a,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let mut imported_codes: Vec<String> = imported
+        .workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| {
+            assert!(matches!(id, FormatId::Custom(peer, _) if peer == LEGACY_PEER));
+            code.to_string()
+        })
+        .collect();
+    imported_codes.sort();
+    assert_eq!(
+        imported_codes,
+        vec![
+            "#,##0.00 USD".to_string(),
+            "0.0000%".to_string(),
+            "yyyy-mm-dd".to_string()
+        ]
+    );
+    for ((row, col), id) in imported.workbook.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(
+            imported.workbook.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),
+            "imported overlay at row {row} must resolve in FormatTable"
+        );
+    }
+
+    let report_b = export_xlsx_path(
+        &imported.workbook,
+        &registry,
+        &xlsx_b,
+        XlsxExportOptions::default(),
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_b), 0);
+
+    let final_log = OpLog::new();
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&imported.workbook, &final_log, "d1-step8-b", &qbook_b).unwrap();
+    let (loaded_final, loaded_final_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_b).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_final_log.len(), 0);
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded_final), custom_codes(&imported.workbook));
+    for ((row, col), id) in loaded_final.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(
+            loaded_final.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),
+            "final qbook overlay at row {row} must resolve in FormatTable"
+        );
+    }
+
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&loaded_final, &final_log, "d1-step8-b", &qbook_c).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(
+        file_tree_bytes(&qbook_b),
+        file_tree_bytes(&qbook_c),
+        "LEGACY-only post-xlsx qbook save should be byte-stable"
+    );
+}

+#[test]
+fn d1_step8_unregistered_overlay_custom_exports_without_a_format_code() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let xlsx = dir.path().join("phantom.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet("S");
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(1.0));
+    let phantom = FormatId::Custom(PeerId::new(777), 0);
+    assert!(wb.formats().lookup(phantom).is_none());
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, phantom);
+
+    let report = export_xlsx_path(&wb, &registry, &xlsx, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report), 1);
+
+    let bytes = fs::read(&xlsx).unwrap();
+    let mut zip = zip::ZipArchive::new(std::io::Cursor::new(bytes.as_slice())).unwrap();
+    let mut styles = String::new();
+    {
+        use std::io::Read;
+        zip.by_name("xl/styles.xml")
+            .unwrap()
+            .read_to_string(&mut styles)
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    assert!(
+        styles.contains(r#"numFmtId="164""#),
+        "cellXfs references flattened phantom id"
+    );
+    assert!(
+        !styles.contains("<numFmt "),
+        "no formatCode is emitted for an unregistered overlay id"
+    );
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let rebound = imported
+        .workbook
+        .sheet(0)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay()
+        .get(0, 0)
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(rebound, FormatId::legacy_from_u32(FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID));
+    assert!(
+        imported.workbook.formats().lookup(rebound).is_none(),
+        "xlsx import accepts a style-bound custom numFmtId with no numFmt definition, \
+         leaving an unresolved overlay id"
+    );
+}

+
+fn file_tree_bytes(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
+    fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, out: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) {
+        let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = fs::read_dir(path)
+            .unwrap()
+            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
+            .collect();
+        entries.sort();
+        for entry in entries {
+            if entry.is_dir() {
+                walk(root, &entry, out);
+            } else {
+                let rel = entry
+                    .strip_prefix(root)
+                    .unwrap()
+                    .to_string_lossy()
+                    .replace('\\', "/");
+                out.insert(rel, fs::read(&entry).unwrap());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
+    walk(root, root, &mut out);
+    out
+}

+    let mut styles = String::new();
+    {

+            .unwrap()
+            .read_to_string(&mut styles)
+            .unwrap();
+    }

+use std::collections::BTreeMap;
+use std::fs;
+use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
+
+fn flatten_count(report: &ql_io_xlsx::XlsxExportReport) -> usize {
+    report
+        .dropped_features
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|f| {
+            matches!(
+                f.kind,
+                UnsupportedFeatureKind::Other("multi-peer-format-id-flatten")
+            )
+        })
+        .count()
+}
+
+fn file_tree_bytes(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
+    fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, out: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) {
+        let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = fs::read_dir(path)
+            .unwrap()
+            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
+            .collect();
+        entries.sort();
+        for entry in entries {
+            if entry.is_dir() {
+                walk(root, &entry, out);
+            } else {
+                let rel = entry
+                    .strip_prefix(root)
+                    .unwrap()
+                    .to_string_lossy()
+                    .replace('\\', "/");
+                out.insert(rel, fs::read(&entry).unwrap());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
+    walk(root, root, &mut out);
+    out
+}
+
+fn custom_codes(workbook: &Workbook) -> Vec<(FormatId, String)> {
+    let mut rows: Vec<_> = workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| (id, code.to_string()))
+        .collect();
+    rows.sort();
+    rows
+}

+    let xlsx_b = dir.path().join("b.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet_with_chunk_rows("Sheet1", 16);
+
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(42));
+    let peer42 = wb.formats_mut().intern("yyyy-mm-dd");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(99));
+    let peer99 = wb.formats_mut().intern("0.0000%");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(LEGACY_PEER);
+    let legacy = wb.formats_mut().intern("#,##0.00 USD");
+    let builtin = FormatId::Builtin(14);
+
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(45000.0));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 1, 0, Value::Number(0.42));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 2, 0, Value::Number(1234.56));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 3, 0, Value::Number(45001.0));
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, peer42);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(1, 0, peer99);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(2, 0, legacy);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(3, 0, builtin);
+
+    let mut oplog = OpLog::new();
+    oplog
+        .append(Op::AddSheet {
+            name: "Sheet1".to_string(),
+            chunk_rows: 16,
+        })
+        .unwrap();
+    for (row, value) in [(0, 45000.0), (1, 0.42), (2, 1234.56), (3, 45001.0)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::PutValue {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                value: CellWireValue::Number(value),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (id, string) in [
+        (peer42, "yyyy-mm-dd"),
+        (peer99, "0.0000%"),
+        (legacy, "#,##0.00 USD"),
+    ] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::RegisterFormat {
+                id: FormatIdWire::from_storage(id),
+                string: string.to_string(),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (row, id) in [(0, peer42), (1, peer99), (2, legacy), (3, builtin)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::SetCellFormat {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                id: Some(FormatIdWire::from_storage(id)),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&wb, &oplog, "d1-step8-a", &qbook_a).unwrap();
+    let oplog_bytes = fs::read(qbook_a.join(OPLOG_FILENAME)).unwrap();
+    assert!(oplog_bytes.starts_with(&OPLOG_MAGIC));

+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded), custom_codes(&wb));
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(0, 0),
+        Some(peer42)
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(1, 0),
+        Some(peer99)
+    );
+    let loaded_ops: Vec<Op> = loaded_log.iter().collect::<Result<_, _>>().unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_ops.len(), 12);

+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_a), 2);
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(

+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()

+    .unwrap();
+    let mut imported_codes: Vec<String> = imported
+        .workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| {
+            assert!(matches!(id, FormatId::Custom(peer, _) if peer == LEGACY_PEER));

+        })

+        assert_eq!(col, 0);

+            imported.workbook.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),
+            "imported overlay at row {row} must resolve in FormatTable"
+        );
+    }
+
+    let report_b = export_xlsx_path(
+        &imported.workbook,
+        &registry,
+        &xlsx_b,
+        XlsxExportOptions::default(),
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_b), 0);
+
+    let final_log = OpLog::new();
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&imported.workbook, &final_log, "d1-step8-b", &qbook_b).unwrap();
+    let (loaded_final, loaded_final_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_b).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_final_log.len(), 0);
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded_final), custom_codes(&imported.workbook));
+    for ((row, col), id) in loaded_final.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {

+    }

+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&loaded_final, &final_log, "d1-step8-b", &qbook_c).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(

+#[test]
+fn d1_step8_unregistered_overlay_custom_exports_without_a_format_code() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let xlsx = dir.path().join("phantom.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet("S");
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(1.0));
+    let phantom = FormatId::Custom(PeerId::new(777), 0);

+        .unwrap()

+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report), 1);
+
+    let bytes = fs::read(&xlsx).unwrap();
+    let mut zip = zip::ZipArchive::new(std::io::Cursor::new(bytes.as_slice())).unwrap();
+    let mut styles = String::new();
+    {
+        use std::io::Read;
+        zip.by_name("xl/styles.xml")
+            .unwrap()
+            .read_to_string(&mut styles)
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    assert!(
+        styles.contains(r#"numFmtId="164""#),
+        "cellXfs references flattened phantom id"
+    );
+    assert!(

+    );

+
+fn flatten_count(report: &ql_io_xlsx::XlsxExportReport) -> usize {
+    report
+        .dropped_features
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|f| {
+            matches!(
+                f.kind,
+                UnsupportedFeatureKind::Other("multi-peer-format-id-flatten")
+            )
+        })
+        .count()
+}
+
+fn file_tree_bytes(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
+    fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, out: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) {
+        let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = fs::read_dir(path)
+            .unwrap()
+            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
+            .collect();
+        entries.sort();
+        for entry in entries {
+            if entry.is_dir() {
+                walk(root, &entry, out);
+            } else {
+                let rel = entry
+                    .strip_prefix(root)
+                    .unwrap()
+                    .to_string_lossy()
+                    .replace('\\', "/");
+                out.insert(rel, fs::read(&entry).unwrap());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
+    walk(root, root, &mut out);
+    out
+}
+
+fn custom_codes(workbook: &Workbook) -> Vec<(FormatId, String)> {
+    let mut rows: Vec<_> = workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| (id, code.to_string()))
+        .collect();
+    rows.sort();
+    rows
+}

+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()

+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()

+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()

+            .append(Op::PutValue {

+            .unwrap();

+            .append(Op::RegisterFormat {

+            .append(Op::SetCellFormat {

+                col: 0,

+#[test]
+fn d1_step8_unregistered_overlay_custom_exports_without_a_format_code() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let xlsx = dir.path().join("phantom.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet("S");
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(1.0));
+    let phantom = FormatId::Custom(PeerId::new(777), 0);
+    assert!(wb.formats().lookup(phantom).is_none());
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, phantom);
+
+    let report = export_xlsx_path(&wb, &registry, &xlsx, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report), 1);
+
+    let bytes = fs::read(&xlsx).unwrap();
+    let mut zip = zip::ZipArchive::new(std::io::Cursor::new(bytes.as_slice())).unwrap();
+    let mut styles = String::new();
+    {
+        use std::io::Read;
+        zip.by_name("xl/styles.xml")
+            .unwrap()
+            .read_to_string(&mut styles)
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    assert!(
+        styles.contains(r#"numFmtId="164""#),
+        "cellXfs references flattened phantom id"
+    );
+    assert!(
+        !styles.contains("<numFmt "),
+        "no formatCode is emitted for an unregistered overlay id"
+    );
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let rebound = imported
+        .workbook
+        .sheet(0)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay()
+        .get(0, 0)
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(rebound, FormatId::legacy_from_u32(FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID));
+    assert!(
+        imported.workbook.formats().lookup(rebound).is_none(),
+        "xlsx import accepts a style-bound custom numFmtId with no numFmt definition, \
+         leaving an unresolved overlay id"
+    );
