    /// Export the log to a binary blob suitable for on-disk persistence.
    /// Uses Loro's `ExportMode::Snapshot` — includes full state + history,
    /// compressed.
    pub fn export_bytes(&self) -> Result<Vec<u8>, OpLogError> {
        Ok(self.doc.export(ExportMode::Snapshot)?)
    }

    /// Reconstruct an `OpLog` from a previously-exported snapshot.
    /// If the snapshot doesn't carry our `"ops"` container shape,
    /// subsequent `iter` / `len` calls operate on an empty list
    /// (Loro creates absent root containers on first access).
    pub fn import_bytes(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<Self, OpLogError> {
        let doc = LoroDoc::new();
        doc.import(bytes)?;
        Ok(Self { doc })
    }

    /// **Phase 5.2 D-4 (2026-05-19):** merge another peer's snapshot
    /// into this log via Loro's CRDT merge. Concurrent appends to
    /// the `"ops"` LoroList are preserved in deterministic causal
    /// order (Fugue/origin-based with peer-id tiebreaker per
    /// `loro-internal::container::richtext::tracker::crdt_rope`).
    ///
    /// Typical pattern for multi-peer collaboration:
    /// 1. Both peers start from a shared snapshot (`import_bytes`).
    /// 2. Each peer appends its own ops independently.
    /// 3. Peer A exports its current state via `export_bytes`.
    /// 4. Peer B calls `merge_bytes(&a_bytes)` — peer B's log now
    ///    contains both peers' ops in causal order.
    /// 5. Replay against a workbook reconstructs the merged state.
    /// 6. `WorkbookRuntime::recompute_all` resolves derived state
    ///    (spills, formula values) from the merged final state.
    ///

+fn flatten_count(report: &ql_io_xlsx::XlsxExportReport) -> usize {
+    report
+        .dropped_features
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|f| {
+            matches!(
+                f.kind,
+                UnsupportedFeatureKind::Other("multi-peer-format-id-flatten")
+            )
+        })
+        .count()
+}
+
+fn file_tree_bytes(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
+    fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, out: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) {
+        let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = fs::read_dir(path)
+            .unwrap()
+            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
+            .collect();
+        entries.sort();
+        for entry in entries {
+            if entry.is_dir() {
+                walk(root, &entry, out);
+            } else {
+                let rel = entry
+                    .strip_prefix(root)
+                    .unwrap()
+                    .to_string_lossy()
+                    .replace('\\', "/");
+                out.insert(rel, fs::read(&entry).unwrap());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
+    walk(root, root, &mut out);
+    out
+}

+fn custom_codes(workbook: &Workbook) -> Vec<(FormatId, String)> {
+    let mut rows: Vec<_> = workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| (id, code.to_string()))
+        .collect();
+    rows.sort();
+    rows
+}

+use loro::{ExportMode, LoroDoc, LoroValue};
+use ql_oplog::{OpLog, OpLogError};
+
+#[test]
+fn pre_step4_register_format_json_loads_as_loro_then_fails_at_iter() {
+    let doc = LoroDoc::new();
+    let list = doc.get_list("ops");
+    list.push(LoroValue::from(
+        r#"{"kind":"RegisterFormat","id":164,"string":"yyyy-mm-dd"}"#,
+    ))
+    .unwrap();
+    doc.commit();
+
+    let raw_loro = doc.export(ExportMode::Snapshot).unwrap();
+    assert_ne!(&raw_loro[..4.min(raw_loro.len())], b"QLOL");
+
+    let log = OpLog::import_bytes(&raw_loro).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(log.len(), 1);
+    let first = log.iter().next().expect("one visible op");
+    match first {
+        Err(OpLogError::Deserialize { index, source }) => {
+            assert_eq!(index, 0);
+            assert!(
+                source.to_string().contains("invalid type")
+                    || source.to_string().contains("expected struct variant")
+                    || source.to_string().contains("expected map"),
+                "unexpected serde error: {source}"
+            );
+        }
+        other => panic!("expected deserialize failure, got {other:?}"),
+    }
+}

+    let (loaded_final, loaded_final_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_b).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_final_log.len(), 0);
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded_final), custom_codes(&imported.workbook));
+    for ((row, col), id) in loaded_final.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);

+    assert_eq!(

+#[test]
+fn d1_step8_unregistered_overlay_custom_exports_without_a_format_code() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let xlsx = dir.path().join("phantom.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();

+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report), 1);
+

+    let mut styles = String::new();

+    }
+    assert!(
+        styles.contains(r#"numFmtId="164""#),
+        "cellXfs references flattened phantom id"
+    );

+    );
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx,

+}

+use loro::{ExportMode, LoroDoc, LoroValue};
+use ql_oplog::{OpLog, OpLogError};
+
+#[test]
+fn pre_step4_register_format_json_loads_as_loro_then_fails_at_iter() {
+    let doc = LoroDoc::new();
+    let list = doc.get_list("ops");
+    list.push(LoroValue::from(
+        r#"{"kind":"RegisterFormat","id":164,"string":"yyyy-mm-dd"}"#,
+    ))
+    .unwrap();
+    doc.commit();
+
+    let raw_loro = doc.export(ExportMode::Snapshot).unwrap();
+    assert_ne!(&raw_loro[..4.min(raw_loro.len())], b"QLOL");
+
+    let log = OpLog::import_bytes(&raw_loro).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(log.len(), 1);
+    let first = log.iter().next().expect("one visible op");
+    match first {
+        Err(OpLogError::Deserialize { index, source }) => {
+            assert_eq!(index, 0);
+            assert!(
+                source.to_string().contains("invalid type")
+                    || source.to_string().contains("expected struct variant")
+                    || source.to_string().contains("expected map"),
+                "unexpected serde error: {source}"
+            );
+        }
+        other => panic!("expected deserialize failure, got {other:?}"),
+    }
+}

+#![allow(deprecated)]
+
+use ql_io::{load_workbook_with_oplog, save_workbook_with_oplog, OPLOG_FILENAME, OPLOG_MAGIC};
+use ql_io_xlsx::{
+    export_xlsx_path, import_xlsx_path, RecomputeMode, UnsupportedFeatureKind, XlsxExportOptions,
+    XlsxImportOptions,
+};
+use ql_oplog::{CellWireValue, FormatIdWire, Op, OpLog};
+use ql_storage::{FormatId, Workbook, FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID};
+use ql_types::{PeerId, Value, LEGACY_PEER};
+use std::collections::BTreeMap;
+use std::fs;
+use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
+
+fn flatten_count(report: &ql_io_xlsx::XlsxExportReport) -> usize {
+    report
+        .dropped_features
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|f| {
+            matches!(
+                f.kind,
+                UnsupportedFeatureKind::Other("multi-peer-format-id-flatten")
+            )
+        })
+        .count()
+}
+
+fn file_tree_bytes(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
+    fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, out: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) {
+        let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = fs::read_dir(path)
+            .unwrap()
+            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
+            .collect();
+        entries.sort();
+        for entry in entries {
+            if entry.is_dir() {
+                walk(root, &entry, out);
+            } else {
+                let rel = entry
+                    .strip_prefix(root)
+                    .unwrap()
+                    .to_string_lossy()
+                    .replace('\\', "/");
+                out.insert(rel, fs::read(&entry).unwrap());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
+    walk(root, root, &mut out);
+    out
+}
+
+fn custom_codes(workbook: &Workbook) -> Vec<(FormatId, String)> {
+    let mut rows: Vec<_> = workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| (id, code.to_string()))
+        .collect();
+    rows.sort();
+    rows
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn d1_step8_full_arc_multi_peer_qbook_xlsx_qbook_round_trip() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let qbook_a = dir.path().join("a.qbook");
+    let qbook_b = dir.path().join("b.qbook");
+    let qbook_c = dir.path().join("c.qbook");
+    let xlsx_a = dir.path().join("a.xlsx");
+    let xlsx_b = dir.path().join("b.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet_with_chunk_rows("Sheet1", 16);
+
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(42));
+    let peer42 = wb.formats_mut().intern("yyyy-mm-dd");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(99));
+    let peer99 = wb.formats_mut().intern("0.0000%");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(LEGACY_PEER);
+    let legacy = wb.formats_mut().intern("#,##0.00 USD");
+    let builtin = FormatId::Builtin(14);
+
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(45000.0));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 1, 0, Value::Number(0.42));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 2, 0, Value::Number(1234.56));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 3, 0, Value::Number(45001.0));
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, peer42);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(1, 0, peer99);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(2, 0, legacy);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(3, 0, builtin);
+
+    let mut oplog = OpLog::new();
+    oplog
+        .append(Op::AddSheet {
+            name: "Sheet1".to_string(),
+            chunk_rows: 16,
+        })
+        .unwrap();
+    for (row, value) in [(0, 45000.0), (1, 0.42), (2, 1234.56), (3, 45001.0)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::PutValue {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                value: CellWireValue::Number(value),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (id, string) in [
+        (peer42, "yyyy-mm-dd"),
+        (peer99, "0.0000%"),
+        (legacy, "#,##0.00 USD"),
+    ] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::RegisterFormat {
+                id: FormatIdWire::from_storage(id),
+                string: string.to_string(),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (row, id) in [(0, peer42), (1, peer99), (2, legacy), (3, builtin)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::SetCellFormat {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                id: Some(FormatIdWire::from_storage(id)),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&wb, &oplog, "d1-step8-a", &qbook_a).unwrap();
+    let oplog_bytes = fs::read(qbook_a.join(OPLOG_FILENAME)).unwrap();
+    assert!(oplog_bytes.starts_with(&OPLOG_MAGIC));
+
+    let (loaded, loaded_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_a).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded), custom_codes(&wb));
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(0, 0),
+        Some(peer42)
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(1, 0),
+        Some(peer99)
+    );
+    let loaded_ops: Vec<Op> = loaded_log.iter().collect::<Result<_, _>>().unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_ops.len(), 12);
+
+    let report_a =
+        export_xlsx_path(&loaded, &registry, &xlsx_a, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_a), 2);
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx_a,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let mut imported_codes: Vec<String> = imported
+        .workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| {
+            assert!(matches!(id, FormatId::Custom(peer, _) if peer == LEGACY_PEER));
+            code.to_string()
+        })
+        .collect();
+    imported_codes.sort();
+    assert_eq!(
+        imported_codes,
+        vec![
+            "#,##0.00 USD".to_string(),
+            "0.0000%".to_string(),
+            "yyyy-mm-dd".to_string()
+        ]
+    );
+    for ((row, col), id) in imported.workbook.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(
+            imported.workbook.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),
+            "imported overlay at row {row} must resolve in FormatTable"
+        );
+    }
+
+    let report_b = export_xlsx_path(
+        &imported.workbook,
+        &registry,
+        &xlsx_b,
+        XlsxExportOptions::default(),
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_b), 0);
+
+    let final_log = OpLog::new();
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&imported.workbook, &final_log, "d1-step8-b", &qbook_b).unwrap();
+    let (loaded_final, loaded_final_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_b).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_final_log.len(), 0);
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded_final), custom_codes(&imported.workbook));
+    for ((row, col), id) in loaded_final.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(
+            loaded_final.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),
+            "final qbook overlay at row {row} must resolve in FormatTable"
+        );
+    }
+
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&loaded_final, &final_log, "d1-step8-b", &qbook_c).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(
+        file_tree_bytes(&qbook_b),
+        file_tree_bytes(&qbook_c),
+        "LEGACY-only post-xlsx qbook save should be byte-stable"
+    );
+}

+            .append(Op::PutValue {

+                col: 0,

+            .append(Op::RegisterFormat {
+                id: FormatIdWire::from_storage(id),
+                string: string.to_string(),

+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (row, id) in [(0, peer42), (1, peer99), (2, legacy), (3, builtin)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::SetCellFormat {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                id: Some(FormatIdWire::from_storage(id)),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&wb, &oplog, "d1-step8-a", &qbook_a).unwrap();
+    let oplog_bytes = fs::read(qbook_a.join(OPLOG_FILENAME)).unwrap();
+    assert!(oplog_bytes.starts_with(&OPLOG_MAGIC));
+
+    let (loaded, loaded_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_a).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded), custom_codes(&wb));
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(0, 0),
+        Some(peer42)
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(1, 0),
+        Some(peer99)
+    );
+    let loaded_ops: Vec<Op> = loaded_log.iter().collect::<Result<_, _>>().unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_ops.len(), 12);
+
+    let report_a =

+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_a), 2);
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(

+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()

+    let mut imported_codes: Vec<String> = imported
+        .workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| {

+        );
+    }

+    for ((row, col), id) in loaded_final.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {

+    assert_eq!(

+        "LEGACY-only post-xlsx qbook save should be byte-stable"
+    );

+#[test]
+fn d1_step8_unregistered_overlay_custom_exports_without_a_format_code() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let xlsx = dir.path().join("phantom.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet("S");
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(1.0));
+    let phantom = FormatId::Custom(PeerId::new(777), 0);
+    assert!(wb.formats().lookup(phantom).is_none());
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, phantom);
+
+    let report = export_xlsx_path(&wb, &registry, &xlsx, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report), 1);
+
+    let bytes = fs::read(&xlsx).unwrap();
+    let mut zip = zip::ZipArchive::new(std::io::Cursor::new(bytes.as_slice())).unwrap();
+    let mut styles = String::new();
+    {
+        use std::io::Read;
+        zip.by_name("xl/styles.xml")
+            .unwrap()
+            .read_to_string(&mut styles)
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    assert!(
+        styles.contains(r#"numFmtId="164""#),
+        "cellXfs references flattened phantom id"
+    );
+    assert!(
+        !styles.contains("<numFmt "),
+        "no formatCode is emitted for an unregistered overlay id"
+    );
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let rebound = imported
+        .workbook
+        .sheet(0)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay()
+        .get(0, 0)
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(rebound, FormatId::legacy_from_u32(FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID));
+    assert!(
+        imported.workbook.formats().lookup(rebound).is_none(),
+        "xlsx import accepts a style-bound custom numFmtId with no numFmt definition, \
+         leaving an unresolved overlay id"
+    );
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+use loro::{ExportMode, LoroDoc, LoroValue};
+use ql_oplog::{OpLog, OpLogError};
+
+#[test]
+fn pre_step4_register_format_json_loads_as_loro_then_fails_at_iter() {
+    let doc = LoroDoc::new();
+    let list = doc.get_list("ops");
+    list.push(LoroValue::from(
+        r#"{"kind":"RegisterFormat","id":164,"string":"yyyy-mm-dd"}"#,
+    ))
+    .unwrap();
+    doc.commit();
+
+    let raw_loro = doc.export(ExportMode::Snapshot).unwrap();
+    assert_ne!(&raw_loro[..4.min(raw_loro.len())], b"QLOL");
+
+    let log = OpLog::import_bytes(&raw_loro).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(log.len(), 1);
+    let first = log.iter().next().expect("one visible op");
+    match first {
+        Err(OpLogError::Deserialize { index, source }) => {
+            assert_eq!(index, 0);
+            assert!(
+                source.to_string().contains("invalid type")
+                    || source.to_string().contains("expected struct variant")
+                    || source.to_string().contains("expected map"),
+                "unexpected serde error: {source}"
+            );
+        }
+        other => panic!("expected deserialize failure, got {other:?}"),
+    }
+}

+#![allow(deprecated)]

+use ql_io::{load_workbook_with_oplog, save_workbook_with_oplog, OPLOG_FILENAME, OPLOG_MAGIC};

+
+fn flatten_count(report: &ql_io_xlsx::XlsxExportReport) -> usize {
+    report
+        .dropped_features
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|f| {
+            matches!(
+                f.kind,
+                UnsupportedFeatureKind::Other("multi-peer-format-id-flatten")
+            )
+        })
+        .count()
+}
+
+fn file_tree_bytes(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
+    fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, out: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) {
+        let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = fs::read_dir(path)
+            .unwrap()
+            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
+            .collect();
+        entries.sort();
+        for entry in entries {
+            if entry.is_dir() {
+                walk(root, &entry, out);
+            } else {
+                let rel = entry
+                    .strip_prefix(root)
+                    .unwrap()
+                    .to_string_lossy()
+                    .replace('\\', "/");
+                out.insert(rel, fs::read(&entry).unwrap());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
+    walk(root, root, &mut out);
+    out
+}
+
+fn custom_codes(workbook: &Workbook) -> Vec<(FormatId, String)> {
+    let mut rows: Vec<_> = workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| (id, code.to_string()))
+        .collect();
+    rows.sort();
+    rows
+}

+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                id: Some(FormatIdWire::from_storage(id)),

+            .unwrap();
+    }

+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&wb, &oplog, "d1-step8-a", &qbook_a).unwrap();

+    );

+            code.to_string()
+        })
+        .collect();
+    imported_codes.sort();
+    assert_eq!(

+        vec![
+            "#,##0.00 USD".to_string(),
+            "0.0000%".to_string(),
+            "yyyy-mm-dd".to_string()
+        ]
+    );
+    for ((row, col), id) in imported.workbook.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(
+            imported.workbook.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),

+    let (loaded_final, loaded_final_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_b).unwrap();

+                    .to_string_lossy()
+                    .replace('\\', "/");
+                out.insert(rel, fs::read(&entry).unwrap());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
+    walk(root, root, &mut out);
+    out
+}
+
+fn custom_codes(workbook: &Workbook) -> Vec<(FormatId, String)> {
+    let mut rows: Vec<_> = workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| (id, code.to_string()))
+        .collect();
+    rows.sort();
+    rows
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn d1_step8_full_arc_multi_peer_qbook_xlsx_qbook_round_trip() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let qbook_a = dir.path().join("a.qbook");
+    let qbook_b = dir.path().join("b.qbook");
+    let qbook_c = dir.path().join("c.qbook");
+    let xlsx_a = dir.path().join("a.xlsx");
+    let xlsx_b = dir.path().join("b.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet_with_chunk_rows("Sheet1", 16);
+
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(42));
+    let peer42 = wb.formats_mut().intern("yyyy-mm-dd");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(99));
+    let peer99 = wb.formats_mut().intern("0.0000%");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(LEGACY_PEER);
+    let legacy = wb.formats_mut().intern("#,##0.00 USD");
+    let builtin = FormatId::Builtin(14);
+
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(45000.0));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 1, 0, Value::Number(0.42));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 2, 0, Value::Number(1234.56));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 3, 0, Value::Number(45001.0));
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, peer42);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(1, 0, peer99);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(2, 0, legacy);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(3, 0, builtin);
+
+    let mut oplog = OpLog::new();
+    oplog
+        .append(Op::AddSheet {
+            name: "Sheet1".to_string(),
+            chunk_rows: 16,
+        })
+        .unwrap();
+    for (row, value) in [(0, 45000.0), (1, 0.42), (2, 1234.56), (3, 45001.0)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::PutValue {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                value: CellWireValue::Number(value),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (id, string) in [
+        (peer42, "yyyy-mm-dd"),
+        (peer99, "0.0000%"),
+        (legacy, "#,##0.00 USD"),
+    ] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::RegisterFormat {
+                id: FormatIdWire::from_storage(id),
+                string: string.to_string(),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (row, id) in [(0, peer42), (1, peer99), (2, legacy), (3, builtin)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::SetCellFormat {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                id: Some(FormatIdWire::from_storage(id)),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&wb, &oplog, "d1-step8-a", &qbook_a).unwrap();
+    let oplog_bytes = fs::read(qbook_a.join(OPLOG_FILENAME)).unwrap();
+    assert!(oplog_bytes.starts_with(&OPLOG_MAGIC));
+
+    let (loaded, loaded_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_a).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded), custom_codes(&wb));
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(0, 0),
+        Some(peer42)
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(1, 0),
+        Some(peer99)
+    );
+    let loaded_ops: Vec<Op> = loaded_log.iter().collect::<Result<_, _>>().unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_ops.len(), 12);
+
+    let report_a =
+        export_xlsx_path(&loaded, &registry, &xlsx_a, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_a), 2);
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx_a,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let mut imported_codes: Vec<String> = imported
+        .workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| {
+            assert!(matches!(id, FormatId::Custom(peer, _) if peer == LEGACY_PEER));
+            code.to_string()
+        })
+        .collect();
+    imported_codes.sort();
+    assert_eq!(
+        imported_codes,
+        vec![
+            "#,##0.00 USD".to_string(),
+            "0.0000%".to_string(),
+            "yyyy-mm-dd".to_string()
+        ]
+    );
+    for ((row, col), id) in imported.workbook.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(
+            imported.workbook.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),
+            "imported overlay at row {row} must resolve in FormatTable"
+        );
+    }
+
+    let report_b = export_xlsx_path(
+        &imported.workbook,
+        &registry,
+        &xlsx_b,
+        XlsxExportOptions::default(),
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_b), 0);
+
+    let final_log = OpLog::new();
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&imported.workbook, &final_log, "d1-step8-b", &qbook_b).unwrap();
+    let (loaded_final, loaded_final_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_b).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_final_log.len(), 0);
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded_final), custom_codes(&imported.workbook));
+    for ((row, col), id) in loaded_final.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(
+            loaded_final.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),
+            "final qbook overlay at row {row} must resolve in FormatTable"
+        );
+    }
+
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&loaded_final, &final_log, "d1-step8-b", &qbook_c).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(
+        file_tree_bytes(&qbook_b),
+        file_tree_bytes(&qbook_c),
+        "LEGACY-only post-xlsx qbook save should be byte-stable"
+    );
+}

+#[test]
+fn d1_step8_unregistered_overlay_custom_exports_without_a_format_code() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let xlsx = dir.path().join("phantom.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet("S");
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(1.0));
+    let phantom = FormatId::Custom(PeerId::new(777), 0);
+    assert!(wb.formats().lookup(phantom).is_none());
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, phantom);
+
+    let report = export_xlsx_path(&wb, &registry, &xlsx, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report), 1);
+
+    let bytes = fs::read(&xlsx).unwrap();
+    let mut zip = zip::ZipArchive::new(std::io::Cursor::new(bytes.as_slice())).unwrap();
+    let mut styles = String::new();
+    {
+        use std::io::Read;
+        zip.by_name("xl/styles.xml")
+            .unwrap()
+            .read_to_string(&mut styles)
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    assert!(
+        styles.contains(r#"numFmtId="164""#),
+        "cellXfs references flattened phantom id"
+    );
+    assert!(
+        !styles.contains("<numFmt "),
+        "no formatCode is emitted for an unregistered overlay id"
+    );
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let rebound = imported
+        .workbook
+        .sheet(0)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay()
+        .get(0, 0)
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(rebound, FormatId::legacy_from_u32(FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID));
+    assert!(
+        imported.workbook.formats().lookup(rebound).is_none(),
+        "xlsx import accepts a style-bound custom numFmtId with no numFmt definition, \
+         leaving an unresolved overlay id"
+    );
+}

+use loro::{ExportMode, LoroDoc, LoroValue};
+use ql_oplog::{OpLog, OpLogError};
+
+#[test]
+fn pre_step4_register_format_json_loads_as_loro_then_fails_at_iter() {
+    let doc = LoroDoc::new();
+    let list = doc.get_list("ops");
+    list.push(LoroValue::from(
+        r#"{"kind":"RegisterFormat","id":164,"string":"yyyy-mm-dd"}"#,
+    ))
+    .unwrap();
+    doc.commit();
+
+    let raw_loro = doc.export(ExportMode::Snapshot).unwrap();
+    assert_ne!(&raw_loro[..4.min(raw_loro.len())], b"QLOL");
+
+    let log = OpLog::import_bytes(&raw_loro).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(log.len(), 1);
+    let first = log.iter().next().expect("one visible op");
+    match first {
+        Err(OpLogError::Deserialize { index, source }) => {
+            assert_eq!(index, 0);
+            assert!(
+                source.to_string().contains("invalid type")
+                    || source.to_string().contains("expected struct variant")
+                    || source.to_string().contains("expected map"),
+                "unexpected serde error: {source}"
+            );
+        }
+        other => panic!("expected deserialize failure, got {other:?}"),
+    }
+}

+fn flatten_count(report: &ql_io_xlsx::XlsxExportReport) -> usize {
+    report
+        .dropped_features
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|f| {
+            matches!(
+                f.kind,
+                UnsupportedFeatureKind::Other("multi-peer-format-id-flatten")
+            )
+        })
+        .count()
+}
+
+fn file_tree_bytes(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
+    fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, out: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) {
+        let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = fs::read_dir(path)
+            .unwrap()
+            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
+            .collect();
+        entries.sort();
+        for entry in entries {
+            if entry.is_dir() {
+                walk(root, &entry, out);
+            } else {
+                let rel = entry
+                    .strip_prefix(root)
+                    .unwrap()
+                    .to_string_lossy()
+                    .replace('\\', "/");
+                out.insert(rel, fs::read(&entry).unwrap());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
+    walk(root, root, &mut out);
+    out
+}

+use ql_io::{load_workbook_with_oplog, save_workbook_with_oplog, OPLOG_FILENAME, OPLOG_MAGIC};

+
+fn flatten_count(report: &ql_io_xlsx::XlsxExportReport) -> usize {
+    report
+        .dropped_features
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|f| {
+            matches!(
+                f.kind,
+                UnsupportedFeatureKind::Other("multi-peer-format-id-flatten")
+            )
+        })
+        .count()
+}
+
+fn file_tree_bytes(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
+    fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, out: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) {
+        let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = fs::read_dir(path)
+            .unwrap()
+            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
+            .collect();
+        entries.sort();
+        for entry in entries {
+            if entry.is_dir() {
+                walk(root, &entry, out);
+            } else {
+                let rel = entry
+                    .strip_prefix(root)
+                    .unwrap()
+                    .to_string_lossy()
+                    .replace('\\', "/");
+                out.insert(rel, fs::read(&entry).unwrap());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
+    walk(root, root, &mut out);
+    out
+}
+
+fn custom_codes(workbook: &Workbook) -> Vec<(FormatId, String)> {
+    let mut rows: Vec<_> = workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| (id, code.to_string()))
+        .collect();
+    rows.sort();
+    rows
+}

+#[test]
+fn d1_step8_full_arc_multi_peer_qbook_xlsx_qbook_round_trip() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let qbook_a = dir.path().join("a.qbook");
+    let qbook_b = dir.path().join("b.qbook");
+    let qbook_c = dir.path().join("c.qbook");
+    let xlsx_a = dir.path().join("a.xlsx");
+    let xlsx_b = dir.path().join("b.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet_with_chunk_rows("Sheet1", 16);
+
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(42));
+    let peer42 = wb.formats_mut().intern("yyyy-mm-dd");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(99));
+    let peer99 = wb.formats_mut().intern("0.0000%");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(LEGACY_PEER);
+    let legacy = wb.formats_mut().intern("#,##0.00 USD");
+    let builtin = FormatId::Builtin(14);
+
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(45000.0));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 1, 0, Value::Number(0.42));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 2, 0, Value::Number(1234.56));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 3, 0, Value::Number(45001.0));
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, peer42);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(1, 0, peer99);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(2, 0, legacy);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(3, 0, builtin);
+
+    let mut oplog = OpLog::new();
+    oplog
+        .append(Op::AddSheet {
+            name: "Sheet1".to_string(),
+            chunk_rows: 16,
+        })
+        .unwrap();
+    for (row, value) in [(0, 45000.0), (1, 0.42), (2, 1234.56), (3, 45001.0)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::PutValue {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                value: CellWireValue::Number(value),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (id, string) in [
+        (peer42, "yyyy-mm-dd"),
+        (peer99, "0.0000%"),
+        (legacy, "#,##0.00 USD"),
+    ] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::RegisterFormat {
+                id: FormatIdWire::from_storage(id),
+                string: string.to_string(),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (row, id) in [(0, peer42), (1, peer99), (2, legacy), (3, builtin)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::SetCellFormat {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                id: Some(FormatIdWire::from_storage(id)),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&wb, &oplog, "d1-step8-a", &qbook_a).unwrap();
+    let oplog_bytes = fs::read(qbook_a.join(OPLOG_FILENAME)).unwrap();
+    assert!(oplog_bytes.starts_with(&OPLOG_MAGIC));
+
+    let (loaded, loaded_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_a).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded), custom_codes(&wb));
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(0, 0),
+        Some(peer42)
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(1, 0),
+        Some(peer99)
+    );
+    let loaded_ops: Vec<Op> = loaded_log.iter().collect::<Result<_, _>>().unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_ops.len(), 12);
+
+    let report_a =
+        export_xlsx_path(&loaded, &registry, &xlsx_a, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_a), 2);
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx_a,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let mut imported_codes: Vec<String> = imported
+        .workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| {
+            assert!(matches!(id, FormatId::Custom(peer, _) if peer == LEGACY_PEER));
+            code.to_string()
+        })
+        .collect();
+    imported_codes.sort();
+    assert_eq!(
+        imported_codes,
+        vec![
+            "#,##0.00 USD".to_string(),
+            "0.0000%".to_string(),
+            "yyyy-mm-dd".to_string()
+        ]
+    );
+    for ((row, col), id) in imported.workbook.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(
+            imported.workbook.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),
+            "imported overlay at row {row} must resolve in FormatTable"
+        );
+    }
+
+    let report_b = export_xlsx_path(
+        &imported.workbook,
+        &registry,
+        &xlsx_b,
+        XlsxExportOptions::default(),
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_b), 0);
+
+    let final_log = OpLog::new();
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&imported.workbook, &final_log, "d1-step8-b", &qbook_b).unwrap();
+    let (loaded_final, loaded_final_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_b).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_final_log.len(), 0);
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded_final), custom_codes(&imported.workbook));
+    for ((row, col), id) in loaded_final.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(
+            loaded_final.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),
+            "final qbook overlay at row {row} must resolve in FormatTable"
+        );
+    }
+
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&loaded_final, &final_log, "d1-step8-b", &qbook_c).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(
+        file_tree_bytes(&qbook_b),
+        file_tree_bytes(&qbook_c),
+        "LEGACY-only post-xlsx qbook save should be byte-stable"
+    );
+}

+#[test]
+fn d1_step8_unregistered_overlay_custom_exports_without_a_format_code() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let xlsx = dir.path().join("phantom.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet("S");
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(1.0));
+    let phantom = FormatId::Custom(PeerId::new(777), 0);
+    assert!(wb.formats().lookup(phantom).is_none());
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, phantom);
+
+    let report = export_xlsx_path(&wb, &registry, &xlsx, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report), 1);
+
+    let bytes = fs::read(&xlsx).unwrap();
+    let mut zip = zip::ZipArchive::new(std::io::Cursor::new(bytes.as_slice())).unwrap();
+    let mut styles = String::new();
+    {
+        use std::io::Read;
+        zip.by_name("xl/styles.xml")
+            .unwrap()
+            .read_to_string(&mut styles)
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    assert!(
+        styles.contains(r#"numFmtId="164""#),
+        "cellXfs references flattened phantom id"
+    );
+    assert!(
+        !styles.contains("<numFmt "),
+        "no formatCode is emitted for an unregistered overlay id"
+    );
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let rebound = imported
+        .workbook
+        .sheet(0)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay()
+        .get(0, 0)
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(rebound, FormatId::legacy_from_u32(FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID));
+    assert!(
+        imported.workbook.formats().lookup(rebound).is_none(),
+        "xlsx import accepts a style-bound custom numFmtId with no numFmt definition, \
+         leaving an unresolved overlay id"
+    );
+}

+fn flatten_count(report: &ql_io_xlsx::XlsxExportReport) -> usize {
+    report
+        .dropped_features
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|f| {
+            matches!(
+                f.kind,
+                UnsupportedFeatureKind::Other("multi-peer-format-id-flatten")
+            )
+        })
+        .count()

+
+fn file_tree_bytes(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
+    fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, out: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) {
+        let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = fs::read_dir(path)
+            .unwrap()
+            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
+            .collect();
+        entries.sort();
+        for entry in entries {
+            if entry.is_dir() {
+                walk(root, &entry, out);
+            } else {
+                let rel = entry
+                    .strip_prefix(root)
+                    .unwrap()
+                    .to_string_lossy()
+                    .replace('\\', "/");
+                out.insert(rel, fs::read(&entry).unwrap());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
+    walk(root, root, &mut out);
+    out
+}

+        .map(|(id, code)| (id, code.to_string()))
+        .collect();

+fn flatten_count(report: &ql_io_xlsx::XlsxExportReport) -> usize {
+    report
+        .dropped_features
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|f| {
+            matches!(
+                f.kind,
+                UnsupportedFeatureKind::Other("multi-peer-format-id-flatten")
+            )
+        })
+        .count()
+}
+
+fn file_tree_bytes(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
+    fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, out: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) {
+        let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = fs::read_dir(path)
+            .unwrap()
+            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
+            .collect();
+        entries.sort();
+        for entry in entries {
+            if entry.is_dir() {
+                walk(root, &entry, out);
+            } else {
+                let rel = entry
+                    .strip_prefix(root)
+                    .unwrap()
+                    .to_string_lossy()
+                    .replace('\\', "/");
+                out.insert(rel, fs::read(&entry).unwrap());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
+    walk(root, root, &mut out);
+    out
+}
+
+fn custom_codes(workbook: &Workbook) -> Vec<(FormatId, String)> {
+    let mut rows: Vec<_> = workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| (id, code.to_string()))
+        .collect();
+    rows.sort();
+    rows
+}

+#[test]
+fn d1_step8_full_arc_multi_peer_qbook_xlsx_qbook_round_trip() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let qbook_a = dir.path().join("a.qbook");
+    let qbook_b = dir.path().join("b.qbook");
+    let qbook_c = dir.path().join("c.qbook");
+    let xlsx_a = dir.path().join("a.xlsx");
+    let xlsx_b = dir.path().join("b.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet_with_chunk_rows("Sheet1", 16);
+
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(42));
+    let peer42 = wb.formats_mut().intern("yyyy-mm-dd");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(99));
+    let peer99 = wb.formats_mut().intern("0.0000%");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(LEGACY_PEER);
+    let legacy = wb.formats_mut().intern("#,##0.00 USD");
+    let builtin = FormatId::Builtin(14);
+
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(45000.0));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 1, 0, Value::Number(0.42));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 2, 0, Value::Number(1234.56));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 3, 0, Value::Number(45001.0));
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, peer42);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(1, 0, peer99);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(2, 0, legacy);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(3, 0, builtin);
+
+    let mut oplog = OpLog::new();
+    oplog
+        .append(Op::AddSheet {
+            name: "Sheet1".to_string(),
+            chunk_rows: 16,
+        })
+        .unwrap();
+    for (row, value) in [(0, 45000.0), (1, 0.42), (2, 1234.56), (3, 45001.0)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::PutValue {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                value: CellWireValue::Number(value),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (id, string) in [
+        (peer42, "yyyy-mm-dd"),
+        (peer99, "0.0000%"),
+        (legacy, "#,##0.00 USD"),
+    ] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::RegisterFormat {
+                id: FormatIdWire::from_storage(id),
+                string: string.to_string(),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (row, id) in [(0, peer42), (1, peer99), (2, legacy), (3, builtin)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::SetCellFormat {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                id: Some(FormatIdWire::from_storage(id)),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&wb, &oplog, "d1-step8-a", &qbook_a).unwrap();
+    let oplog_bytes = fs::read(qbook_a.join(OPLOG_FILENAME)).unwrap();
+    assert!(oplog_bytes.starts_with(&OPLOG_MAGIC));
+
+    let (loaded, loaded_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_a).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded), custom_codes(&wb));
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(0, 0),
+        Some(peer42)
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(1, 0),
+        Some(peer99)
+    );
+    let loaded_ops: Vec<Op> = loaded_log.iter().collect::<Result<_, _>>().unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_ops.len(), 12);
+
+    let report_a =
+        export_xlsx_path(&loaded, &registry, &xlsx_a, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_a), 2);
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx_a,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let mut imported_codes: Vec<String> = imported
+        .workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| {
+            assert!(matches!(id, FormatId::Custom(peer, _) if peer == LEGACY_PEER));
+            code.to_string()
+        })
+        .collect();
+    imported_codes.sort();
+    assert_eq!(
+        imported_codes,
+        vec![
+            "#,##0.00 USD".to_string(),
+            "0.0000%".to_string(),
+            "yyyy-mm-dd".to_string()
+        ]
+    );
+    for ((row, col), id) in imported.workbook.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(
+            imported.workbook.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),
+            "imported overlay at row {row} must resolve in FormatTable"
+        );
+    }
+
+    let report_b = export_xlsx_path(
+        &imported.workbook,
+        &registry,
+        &xlsx_b,
+        XlsxExportOptions::default(),
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_b), 0);
+
+    let final_log = OpLog::new();
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&imported.workbook, &final_log, "d1-step8-b", &qbook_b).unwrap();
+    let (loaded_final, loaded_final_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_b).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_final_log.len(), 0);
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded_final), custom_codes(&imported.workbook));
+    for ((row, col), id) in loaded_final.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(
+            loaded_final.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),
+            "final qbook overlay at row {row} must resolve in FormatTable"
+        );
+    }
+
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&loaded_final, &final_log, "d1-step8-b", &qbook_c).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(
+        file_tree_bytes(&qbook_b),
+        file_tree_bytes(&qbook_c),
+        "LEGACY-only post-xlsx qbook save should be byte-stable"
+    );
+}

+#[test]
+fn d1_step8_unregistered_overlay_custom_exports_without_a_format_code() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let xlsx = dir.path().join("phantom.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet("S");
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(1.0));
+    let phantom = FormatId::Custom(PeerId::new(777), 0);
+    assert!(wb.formats().lookup(phantom).is_none());
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, phantom);
+
+    let report = export_xlsx_path(&wb, &registry, &xlsx, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report), 1);
+
+    let bytes = fs::read(&xlsx).unwrap();
+    let mut zip = zip::ZipArchive::new(std::io::Cursor::new(bytes.as_slice())).unwrap();
+    let mut styles = String::new();
+    {
+        use std::io::Read;
+        zip.by_name("xl/styles.xml")
+            .unwrap()
+            .read_to_string(&mut styles)
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    assert!(
+        styles.contains(r#"numFmtId="164""#),
+        "cellXfs references flattened phantom id"
+    );
+    assert!(
+        !styles.contains("<numFmt "),
+        "no formatCode is emitted for an unregistered overlay id"
+    );
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let rebound = imported
+        .workbook
+        .sheet(0)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay()
+        .get(0, 0)
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(rebound, FormatId::legacy_from_u32(FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID));
+    assert!(
+        imported.workbook.formats().lookup(rebound).is_none(),
+        "xlsx import accepts a style-bound custom numFmtId with no numFmt definition, \
+         leaving an unresolved overlay id"
+    );
+}

+#![allow(deprecated)]
+
+use ql_io::{load_workbook_with_oplog, save_workbook_with_oplog, OPLOG_FILENAME, OPLOG_MAGIC};
+use ql_io_xlsx::{
+    export_xlsx_path, import_xlsx_path, RecomputeMode, UnsupportedFeatureKind, XlsxExportOptions,
+    XlsxImportOptions,
+};
+use ql_oplog::{CellWireValue, FormatIdWire, Op, OpLog};
+use ql_storage::{FormatId, Workbook, FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID};
+use ql_types::{PeerId, Value, LEGACY_PEER};
+use std::collections::BTreeMap;
+use std::fs;
+use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
+
+fn flatten_count(report: &ql_io_xlsx::XlsxExportReport) -> usize {
+    report
+        .dropped_features
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|f| {
+            matches!(
+                f.kind,
+                UnsupportedFeatureKind::Other("multi-peer-format-id-flatten")
+            )
+        })
+        .count()
+}
+
+fn file_tree_bytes(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
+    fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, out: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) {
+        let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = fs::read_dir(path)
+            .unwrap()
+            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
+            .collect();
+        entries.sort();
+        for entry in entries {
+            if entry.is_dir() {
+                walk(root, &entry, out);
+            } else {
+                let rel = entry
+                    .strip_prefix(root)
+                    .unwrap()
+                    .to_string_lossy()
+                    .replace('\\', "/");
+                out.insert(rel, fs::read(&entry).unwrap());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
+    walk(root, root, &mut out);
+    out
+}
+
+fn custom_codes(workbook: &Workbook) -> Vec<(FormatId, String)> {
+    let mut rows: Vec<_> = workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| (id, code.to_string()))
+        .collect();
+    rows.sort();
+    rows
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn d1_step8_full_arc_multi_peer_qbook_xlsx_qbook_round_trip() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let qbook_a = dir.path().join("a.qbook");
+    let qbook_b = dir.path().join("b.qbook");
+    let qbook_c = dir.path().join("c.qbook");
+    let xlsx_a = dir.path().join("a.xlsx");
+    let xlsx_b = dir.path().join("b.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet_with_chunk_rows("Sheet1", 16);
+
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(42));
+    let peer42 = wb.formats_mut().intern("yyyy-mm-dd");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(99));
+    let peer99 = wb.formats_mut().intern("0.0000%");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(LEGACY_PEER);
+    let legacy = wb.formats_mut().intern("#,##0.00 USD");
+    let builtin = FormatId::Builtin(14);
+
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(45000.0));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 1, 0, Value::Number(0.42));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 2, 0, Value::Number(1234.56));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 3, 0, Value::Number(45001.0));
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, peer42);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(1, 0, peer99);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(2, 0, legacy);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(3, 0, builtin);
+
+    let mut oplog = OpLog::new();
+    oplog
+        .append(Op::AddSheet {
+            name: "Sheet1".to_string(),
+            chunk_rows: 16,
+        })
+        .unwrap();
+    for (row, value) in [(0, 45000.0), (1, 0.42), (2, 1234.56), (3, 45001.0)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::PutValue {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                value: CellWireValue::Number(value),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (id, string) in [
+        (peer42, "yyyy-mm-dd"),
+        (peer99, "0.0000%"),
+        (legacy, "#,##0.00 USD"),
+    ] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::RegisterFormat {
+                id: FormatIdWire::from_storage(id),
+                string: string.to_string(),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (row, id) in [(0, peer42), (1, peer99), (2, legacy), (3, builtin)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::SetCellFormat {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                id: Some(FormatIdWire::from_storage(id)),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&wb, &oplog, "d1-step8-a", &qbook_a).unwrap();
+    let oplog_bytes = fs::read(qbook_a.join(OPLOG_FILENAME)).unwrap();
+    assert!(oplog_bytes.starts_with(&OPLOG_MAGIC));
+
+    let (loaded, loaded_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_a).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded), custom_codes(&wb));
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(0, 0),
+        Some(peer42)
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(1, 0),
+        Some(peer99)
+    );
+    let loaded_ops: Vec<Op> = loaded_log.iter().collect::<Result<_, _>>().unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_ops.len(), 12);
+
+    let report_a =
+        export_xlsx_path(&loaded, &registry, &xlsx_a, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_a), 2);
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx_a,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let mut imported_codes: Vec<String> = imported
+        .workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| {
+            assert!(matches!(id, FormatId::Custom(peer, _) if peer == LEGACY_PEER));
+            code.to_string()
+        })
+        .collect();
+    imported_codes.sort();
+    assert_eq!(
+        imported_codes,
+        vec![
+            "#,##0.00 USD".to_string(),
+            "0.0000%".to_string(),
+            "yyyy-mm-dd".to_string()
+        ]
+    );
+    for ((row, col), id) in imported.workbook.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(
+            imported.workbook.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),
+            "imported overlay at row {row} must resolve in FormatTable"
+        );
+    }
+
+    let report_b = export_xlsx_path(
+        &imported.workbook,
+        &registry,
+        &xlsx_b,
+        XlsxExportOptions::default(),
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_b), 0);
+
+    let final_log = OpLog::new();
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&imported.workbook, &final_log, "d1-step8-b", &qbook_b).unwrap();
+    let (loaded_final, loaded_final_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_b).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_final_log.len(), 0);
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded_final), custom_codes(&imported.workbook));
+    for ((row, col), id) in loaded_final.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(
+            loaded_final.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),
+            "final qbook overlay at row {row} must resolve in FormatTable"
+        );
+    }
+
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&loaded_final, &final_log, "d1-step8-b", &qbook_c).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(
+        file_tree_bytes(&qbook_b),
+        file_tree_bytes(&qbook_c),
+        "LEGACY-only post-xlsx qbook save should be byte-stable"
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn d1_step8_unregistered_overlay_custom_exports_without_a_format_code() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let xlsx = dir.path().join("phantom.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet("S");
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(1.0));
+    let phantom = FormatId::Custom(PeerId::new(777), 0);
+    assert!(wb.formats().lookup(phantom).is_none());
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, phantom);
+
+    let report = export_xlsx_path(&wb, &registry, &xlsx, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report), 1);
+
+    let bytes = fs::read(&xlsx).unwrap();
+    let mut zip = zip::ZipArchive::new(std::io::Cursor::new(bytes.as_slice())).unwrap();
+    let mut styles = String::new();
+    {
+        use std::io::Read;
+        zip.by_name("xl/styles.xml")
+            .unwrap()
+            .read_to_string(&mut styles)
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    assert!(
+        styles.contains(r#"numFmtId="164""#),
+        "cellXfs references flattened phantom id"
+    );
+    assert!(
+        !styles.contains("<numFmt "),
+        "no formatCode is emitted for an unregistered overlay id"
+    );
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let rebound = imported
+        .workbook
+        .sheet(0)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay()
+        .get(0, 0)
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(rebound, FormatId::legacy_from_u32(FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID));
+    assert!(
+        imported.workbook.formats().lookup(rebound).is_none(),
+        "xlsx import accepts a style-bound custom numFmtId with no numFmt definition, \
+         leaving an unresolved overlay id"
+    );
+}

+use ql_io::{load_workbook_with_oplog, save_workbook_with_oplog, OPLOG_FILENAME, OPLOG_MAGIC};

+};

+use ql_storage::{FormatId, Workbook, FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID};
+use ql_types::{PeerId, Value, LEGACY_PEER};
+use std::collections::BTreeMap;
+use std::fs;
+use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
+
+fn flatten_count(report: &ql_io_xlsx::XlsxExportReport) -> usize {
+    report
+        .dropped_features
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|f| {
+            matches!(
+                f.kind,
+                UnsupportedFeatureKind::Other("multi-peer-format-id-flatten")
+            )
+        })
+        .count()
+}
+
+fn file_tree_bytes(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
+    fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, out: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) {
+        let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = fs::read_dir(path)
+            .unwrap()
+            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
+            .collect();
+        entries.sort();
+        for entry in entries {
+            if entry.is_dir() {
+                walk(root, &entry, out);
+            } else {
+                let rel = entry
+                    .strip_prefix(root)
+                    .unwrap()
+                    .to_string_lossy()
+                    .replace('\\', "/");
+                out.insert(rel, fs::read(&entry).unwrap());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
+    walk(root, root, &mut out);
+    out
+}
+
+fn custom_codes(workbook: &Workbook) -> Vec<(FormatId, String)> {
+    let mut rows: Vec<_> = workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| (id, code.to_string()))
+        .collect();
+    rows.sort();
+    rows
+}

+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();

+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(99));
+    let peer99 = wb.formats_mut().intern("0.0000%");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(LEGACY_PEER);
+    let legacy = wb.formats_mut().intern("#,##0.00 USD");
+    let builtin = FormatId::Builtin(14);
+
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(45000.0));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 1, 0, Value::Number(0.42));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 2, 0, Value::Number(1234.56));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 3, 0, Value::Number(45001.0));
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, peer42);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(1, 0, peer99);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(2, 0, legacy);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(3, 0, builtin);
+
+    let mut oplog = OpLog::new();
+    oplog
+        .append(Op::AddSheet {
+            name: "Sheet1".to_string(),
+            chunk_rows: 16,
+        })
+        .unwrap();
+    for (row, value) in [(0, 45000.0), (1, 0.42), (2, 1234.56), (3, 45001.0)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::PutValue {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                value: CellWireValue::Number(value),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }

+        (peer42, "yyyy-mm-dd"),
+        (peer99, "0.0000%"),
+        (legacy, "#,##0.00 USD"),
+    ] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::RegisterFormat {
+                id: FormatIdWire::from_storage(id),
+                string: string.to_string(),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }

+        oplog
+            .append(Op::SetCellFormat {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                id: Some(FormatIdWire::from_storage(id)),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }

+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&wb, &oplog, "d1-step8-a", &qbook_a).unwrap();

+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(0, 0),
+        Some(peer42)
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(1, 0),
+        Some(peer99)
+    );

+        export_xlsx_path(&loaded, &registry, &xlsx_a, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_a), 2);
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx_a,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )

+    let mut imported_codes: Vec<String> = imported

+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| {
+            assert!(matches!(id, FormatId::Custom(peer, _) if peer == LEGACY_PEER));
+            code.to_string()
+        })
+        .collect();
+    imported_codes.sort();
+    assert_eq!(

+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(
+            imported.workbook.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),
+            "imported overlay at row {row} must resolve in FormatTable"
+        );
+    }
+
+    let report_b = export_xlsx_path(
+        &imported.workbook,
+        &registry,
+        &xlsx_b,
+        XlsxExportOptions::default(),
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_b), 0);
+
+    let final_log = OpLog::new();
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&imported.workbook, &final_log, "d1-step8-b", &qbook_b).unwrap();
+    let (loaded_final, loaded_final_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_b).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_final_log.len(), 0);
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded_final), custom_codes(&imported.workbook));
+    for ((row, col), id) in loaded_final.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {

+use ql_io::{load_workbook_with_oplog, save_workbook_with_oplog, OPLOG_FILENAME, OPLOG_MAGIC};

+    XlsxImportOptions,
+};
+use ql_oplog::{CellWireValue, FormatIdWire, Op, OpLog};
+use ql_storage::{FormatId, Workbook, FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID};
+use ql_types::{PeerId, Value, LEGACY_PEER};
+use std::collections::BTreeMap;
+use std::fs;
+use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
+
+fn flatten_count(report: &ql_io_xlsx::XlsxExportReport) -> usize {
+    report
+        .dropped_features
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|f| {
+            matches!(
+                f.kind,
+                UnsupportedFeatureKind::Other("multi-peer-format-id-flatten")
+            )
+        })
+        .count()
+}
+
+fn file_tree_bytes(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
+    fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, out: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) {
+        let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = fs::read_dir(path)
+            .unwrap()
+            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
+            .collect();
+        entries.sort();
+        for entry in entries {
+            if entry.is_dir() {
+                walk(root, &entry, out);
+            } else {
+                let rel = entry
+                    .strip_prefix(root)
+                    .unwrap()
+                    .to_string_lossy()
+                    .replace('\\', "/");
+                out.insert(rel, fs::read(&entry).unwrap());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
+    walk(root, root, &mut out);
+    out
+}
+
+fn custom_codes(workbook: &Workbook) -> Vec<(FormatId, String)> {
+    let mut rows: Vec<_> = workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| (id, code.to_string()))
+        .collect();
+    rows.sort();
+    rows
+}

+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();

+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(99));
+    let peer99 = wb.formats_mut().intern("0.0000%");

+    wb.put_at(sheet, 3, 0, Value::Number(45001.0));
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, peer42);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(1, 0, peer99);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()

+        .format_overlay_mut()

+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }

+            .append(Op::RegisterFormat {
+                id: FormatIdWire::from_storage(id),
+                string: string.to_string(),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }

+        oplog
+            .append(Op::SetCellFormat {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                id: Some(FormatIdWire::from_storage(id)),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&wb, &oplog, "d1-step8-a", &qbook_a).unwrap();

+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(

+        );
+    }

+

+use ql_io::{load_workbook_with_oplog, save_workbook_with_oplog, OPLOG_FILENAME, OPLOG_MAGIC};
+use ql_io_xlsx::{
+    export_xlsx_path, import_xlsx_path, RecomputeMode, UnsupportedFeatureKind, XlsxExportOptions,
+    XlsxImportOptions,

+use std::collections::BTreeMap;

+use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
+
+fn flatten_count(report: &ql_io_xlsx::XlsxExportReport) -> usize {
+    report
+        .dropped_features
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|f| {
+            matches!(
+                f.kind,
+                UnsupportedFeatureKind::Other("multi-peer-format-id-flatten")
+            )
+        })
+        .count()
+}
+
+fn file_tree_bytes(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
+    fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, out: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) {
+        let mut entries: Vec<PathBuf> = fs::read_dir(path)
+            .unwrap()
+            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
+            .collect();
+        entries.sort();
+        for entry in entries {
+            if entry.is_dir() {
+                walk(root, &entry, out);
+            } else {
+                let rel = entry
+                    .strip_prefix(root)
+                    .unwrap()
+                    .to_string_lossy()
+                    .replace('\\', "/");
+                out.insert(rel, fs::read(&entry).unwrap());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
+    walk(root, root, &mut out);
+    out
+}
+
+fn custom_codes(workbook: &Workbook) -> Vec<(FormatId, String)> {
+    let mut rows: Vec<_> = workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| (id, code.to_string()))
+        .collect();
+    rows.sort();
+    rows
+}

+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let qbook_a = dir.path().join("a.qbook");
+    let qbook_b = dir.path().join("b.qbook");
+    let qbook_c = dir.path().join("c.qbook");
+    let xlsx_a = dir.path().join("a.xlsx");
+    let xlsx_b = dir.path().join("b.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet_with_chunk_rows("Sheet1", 16);
+
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(42));
+    let peer42 = wb.formats_mut().intern("yyyy-mm-dd");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(PeerId::new(99));
+    let peer99 = wb.formats_mut().intern("0.0000%");
+    wb.formats_mut().set_local_peer(LEGACY_PEER);
+    let legacy = wb.formats_mut().intern("#,##0.00 USD");
+    let builtin = FormatId::Builtin(14);
+
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(45000.0));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 1, 0, Value::Number(0.42));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 2, 0, Value::Number(1234.56));
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 3, 0, Value::Number(45001.0));
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, peer42);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(1, 0, peer99);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(2, 0, legacy);
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(3, 0, builtin);
+
+    let mut oplog = OpLog::new();
+    oplog
+        .append(Op::AddSheet {
+            name: "Sheet1".to_string(),
+            chunk_rows: 16,
+        })
+        .unwrap();
+    for (row, value) in [(0, 45000.0), (1, 0.42), (2, 1234.56), (3, 45001.0)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::PutValue {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                value: CellWireValue::Number(value),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (id, string) in [
+        (peer42, "yyyy-mm-dd"),
+        (peer99, "0.0000%"),
+        (legacy, "#,##0.00 USD"),
+    ] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::RegisterFormat {
+                id: FormatIdWire::from_storage(id),
+                string: string.to_string(),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    for (row, id) in [(0, peer42), (1, peer99), (2, legacy), (3, builtin)] {
+        oplog
+            .append(Op::SetCellFormat {
+                sheet,
+                row,
+                col: 0,
+                id: Some(FormatIdWire::from_storage(id)),
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&wb, &oplog, "d1-step8-a", &qbook_a).unwrap();
+    let oplog_bytes = fs::read(qbook_a.join(OPLOG_FILENAME)).unwrap();
+    assert!(oplog_bytes.starts_with(&OPLOG_MAGIC));
+
+    let (loaded, loaded_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_a).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded), custom_codes(&wb));
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(0, 0),
+        Some(peer42)
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().get(1, 0),
+        Some(peer99)
+    );
+    let loaded_ops: Vec<Op> = loaded_log.iter().collect::<Result<_, _>>().unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_ops.len(), 12);
+
+    let report_a =
+        export_xlsx_path(&loaded, &registry, &xlsx_a, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_a), 2);
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx_a,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let mut imported_codes: Vec<String> = imported
+        .workbook
+        .formats()
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(id, _)| id.is_custom())
+        .map(|(id, code)| {
+            assert!(matches!(id, FormatId::Custom(peer, _) if peer == LEGACY_PEER));
+            code.to_string()
+        })
+        .collect();
+    imported_codes.sort();
+    assert_eq!(
+        imported_codes,
+        vec![
+            "#,##0.00 USD".to_string(),
+            "0.0000%".to_string(),
+            "yyyy-mm-dd".to_string()
+        ]
+    );
+    for ((row, col), id) in imported.workbook.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(
+            imported.workbook.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),
+            "imported overlay at row {row} must resolve in FormatTable"
+        );
+    }
+
+    let report_b = export_xlsx_path(
+        &imported.workbook,
+        &registry,
+        &xlsx_b,
+        XlsxExportOptions::default(),
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report_b), 0);
+
+    let final_log = OpLog::new();
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&imported.workbook, &final_log, "d1-step8-b", &qbook_b).unwrap();
+    let (loaded_final, loaded_final_log) = load_workbook_with_oplog(&qbook_b).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(loaded_final_log.len(), 0);
+    assert_eq!(custom_codes(&loaded_final), custom_codes(&imported.workbook));
+    for ((row, col), id) in loaded_final.sheet(0).unwrap().format_overlay().iter() {
+        assert_eq!(col, 0);
+        assert!(
+            loaded_final.formats().lookup(id).is_some(),
+            "final qbook overlay at row {row} must resolve in FormatTable"
+        );
+    }
+
+    save_workbook_with_oplog(&loaded_final, &final_log, "d1-step8-b", &qbook_c).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(
+        file_tree_bytes(&qbook_b),
+        file_tree_bytes(&qbook_c),
+        "LEGACY-only post-xlsx qbook save should be byte-stable"
+    );
+}

+#[test]
+fn d1_step8_unregistered_overlay_custom_exports_without_a_format_code() {
+    let registry = ql_functions::default_registry();
+    let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
+    let xlsx = dir.path().join("phantom.xlsx");
+
+    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
+    let sheet = wb.add_sheet("S");
+    wb.put_at(sheet, 0, 0, Value::Number(1.0));
+    let phantom = FormatId::Custom(PeerId::new(777), 0);
+    assert!(wb.formats().lookup(phantom).is_none());
+    wb.sheet_mut(sheet)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay_mut()
+        .set(0, 0, phantom);
+
+    let report = export_xlsx_path(&wb, &registry, &xlsx, XlsxExportOptions::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(flatten_count(&report), 1);
+
+    let bytes = fs::read(&xlsx).unwrap();
+    let mut zip = zip::ZipArchive::new(std::io::Cursor::new(bytes.as_slice())).unwrap();
+    let mut styles = String::new();
+    {
+        use std::io::Read;
+        zip.by_name("xl/styles.xml")
+            .unwrap()
+            .read_to_string(&mut styles)
+            .unwrap();
+    }
+    assert!(
+        styles.contains(r#"numFmtId="164""#),
+        "cellXfs references flattened phantom id"
+    );
+    assert!(
+        !styles.contains("<numFmt "),
+        "no formatCode is emitted for an unregistered overlay id"
+    );
+
+    let imported = import_xlsx_path(
+        &xlsx,
+        &registry,
+        XlsxImportOptions {
+            recompute: RecomputeMode::Skip,
+            ..Default::default()
+        },
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+    let rebound = imported
+        .workbook
+        .sheet(0)
+        .unwrap()
+        .format_overlay()
+        .get(0, 0)
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(rebound, FormatId::legacy_from_u32(FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID));
+    assert!(
+        imported.workbook.formats().lookup(rebound).is_none(),
+        "xlsx import accepts a style-bound custom numFmtId with no numFmt definition, \
+         leaving an unresolved overlay id"
